Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ['Well, hurry it up.', 'Hey, pretty boy.', "Let's see what you can do!", 'Aw, is it that time already?', "Quittin' time. Sorry, but this girl doesn't work after hours. I could, but there wouldn't be a single gil in it for me. We should play again sometime, pretty boy.", 'So, you\'re the "new recruits" they sent over for "special training." Nice cover, runaway prince.', 'At ease, "recruits." There\'s nothing in it for this ex-mercenary to turn you in.', 'At ease, "recruits." There\'s nothing in it for this ex-mercenary to turn you in.', "Let's get this show on the road.", 'Forgot about your "training"? Well, I\'m being paid to escort you... Just watch yourselves in there.', "Search until sundown. It won't do you any good. If you're lookin' to get inside, you're gonna have to wait.", 'Hold down the fort.', 'Hold down the fort.', 'Hold down the fort.', 'Hold down the fort.', 'Only fools rush in, "Your Majesty." Make sure you\'re ready first.', "Hey, Blondie. You sure you and I haven't met somewhere before?", "Nope. But I guess you're right. Probably just my imagination.", "Awww, well, aren't you considerate? I'm good with anything. Surprise me, Four-Eyes.", "Hey, Four-Eyes—you're a pretty good cook.", 'I did. Whaddaya say to cooking for us? My men and I could use a personal chef.', "Why not head inside and look for 'em?", "The empire sniffed it out ages ago. Wait 'til nightfall, shortcake.", 'Bingo.', "Then let's take it.", "Yeah, we'd be lost without you.", 'Who—Biggs and Wedge? They\'re more "subordinates" than they are "friends," but I trust \'em all the same.', 'I doubt we can expect a warm welcome.', 'Yeah, so watch your step.', 'Mind if I finish this one off?', 'Little late for that.', 'That is pretty neat.', "Whoa—If that's the water's surface...", 'Daemons. ‘Til death do us part.', 'The army swore their oaths a long time ago.', "Specimens—and we're stuck harvesting them.", 'Daemons.', 'What do you think it is?', 'Turns out the empire makes weapons out of them.', "Yeah. I'm sure you've seen your share by now.", 'Something not quite right with the empire lately.', "True. Maybe it's time I left.", "Whatever I want. I was a mercenary once. Maybe I'll round up my men and hunt daemons for cash?", "The emperor and new high commander, for starters. Then there's that charmer of a chancellor. I really can't stand that guy.", 'To arms!', "Livelier by the second. C'mon then!", 'Which way?', "These bastards keep gettin' stronger.", "Gotta nip the danger in the bud, The empire's no exception.", 'Not too shabby.', 'The bigger they are, the harder they fall.', 'Aranea.', "Listen—you've seen magitek troopers, right?", "They're born from daemons, in a lab.", 'Darkness is coming. If I were you, I\'d watch my princely ass. Uh—"kingly" ass.', 'Congrats. That concludes your "training." You\'ve still got a hard path ahead, but don\'t let anyone tell you how to walk it.', "Hmph. Tell me something I don't know. You can spare the pleasantries.", 'Oh, right. Thanks—I will. And I\'ll "train" you some more if our paths cross again. Oh, and before I forget—His Excellency instructed me to give you boys a ride back. If you need a lift, feel free to hop on.', "You're headed to Lestallum, right? I'll take you there, but no further.", 'So, ready to ship out?', 'Well, hurry it up.', 'Hold on tight, boys.', "Rise and shine, Prince Charming. We're here.", "Sounds like a spot of trouble's popped up at the power plant. Wish I could help, but I'm powerless to do anything I'm not ordered to. I'll leave the keeping of the peace to you.", 'Good luck, boys.', "Well, look who's here.", 'More to it than meets the eye. You wanna know who to thank? Come with me.', 'What did you do to your eyes?', 'Can you see?', "Wow. That sucks. It's a cruel world.", "Uh, wasn't there one more of you guys?", 'Is he dead?', 'Then quit moping, keep hoping.', "And in the meantime, handle what's at hand.", 'Thank the daemons, pawns of the imperial army.', 'Fought for. My men and I are in the search and rescue business now.', 'Ask away.', "Sure, leave 'em to me... but, who's gonna drive the train?", 'I do. In fact, I know two.', "Your new engineers. Biggs and Wedge. No need to worry—they can take a lickin'.", 'Driving a train. To Gralea.', 'Well, who would you have me ask?', 'Yeah. No sweat.', "The chancellor is running some circus. The high commander got the axe—literally, and the emperor's no more than a husk at this point. Everyone in charge is gone now. It's total chaos—all hell broke loose in the daemon labs.", "Unprogrammed MTs left to run amok... Same for the daemons we caught. And now they're everywhere.", "Yeah, the capital's crawlin' with 'em. As if that wasn't bad enough, the bastards are stronger than ever now. It's gotten too far out of hand for the army to deal with. There's not enough daylight anymore to keep the daemons in one place.", "Then there's the Crystal they stole ‘for the good of the people,' which never sees the light of day. A lot of good it's doing anyone now, locked away in the imperial fortress.", 'About the Crystal... Remember how I said it was locked away?', "They really don't allow anyone near the thing. The emperor himself never got close to it. The lab rats had a theory that the Crystal posed some kind of... threat to the daemons. The way they see it, that's the reason the chancellor had the emperor go after it in the first place. Dunno, but that theory holds water in my book.", "Certainly explains why the kings have always guarded the Crystal, and how they kept the daemons at bay. Long story short, we're stuck in this rut until you go and take back what's yours.", "Don't worry about the civilians. They're in my good hands. Can't say the same for you. Watch yourselves in the capital.", 'You always play hard to get like this?', 'Save it, Blondie. On your feet!', "Sothis is that new model they're working on.", "I dunno what's got you so shook, but you can deal with it later. Let's move.", 'Lose your will to live, and you lose all hope of me helping your sorry ass. Got it?', 'Move it.', "Head there—I'll catch up later.", "I said I'll catch up.", 'Just go!', "Don't tell me you thought that would work.", '"Prompto," right?', "Don't tell me you thought that would work.", 'You could at least look happy to see me.', 'I ran into your buddies in Tenebrae.', "You've got 'em worried sick.", "You spent all that time driving around together and you still don't know what kinda guysthey really are. In case you forgot, your princely pal and I weren't always on such friendly terms. But you know what? He put all that aside and asked me to make sure you were safe.", 'Think he\'d do that for someone who "makes him miserable"?', "All things considered, I guess. Sounds like they've been through a lot since you left, but they're still dead set on getting to the capital.", "They'd have a better shot with you around.", 'Not that I can recall.', "His Highness was so worried about you he could barely speak, but don't worry—I whipped him into shape.", 'Look—I can tell you want to get back together with them. So why not let them know?', "Because you're doing such a great job of living with yourself now.", "Whatdo you want then? You worry so much about what other people want from you that you don't even know what you want anymore! Your life isn't yours to live!", "Forget about what everyone else thinks for a second and figure out what it is you're really after here.", "I'm going after that new model in the morning. You're on your own now, kid.", "Alright—but slow me down and you're going to get left behind.", "According to my intel, they're housing the new model here.", "This one's got a ghost in the machine: Chief Besithia himself. Managed to fuse his soul with the core.", "The daemons this guy created destroyed Insomnia. If we don't take him out now... ... he's liable to destroy the whole world.", 'Our cue to go.', "Hey, you're not so worthless.", 'Not half bad.', "You're a natural.", 'Hop on!', 'Ready for round two?', 'That maniac\'s taken "biological warfare" to the next level.', 'Down below!', "It ain't over.", "Three o'clock!", 'Incoming—look out!', 'Sharp shooting, kid. Keep it up!', 'You alright?', 'Then say it like you mean it. You did good, kid.', "Don't get ahead of yourself.", "The boy has become a man. Anyway, Gralea's straight ahead.", 'Yeah?']

Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ["I'm afraid you're out of luck.", 'The boats bring you here.', "Well, they'll not take you forth.", "I'm an impatient traveler, ready to turn ship. The ceasefire's getting us nowhere.", 'Consider it your allowance.', 'A man of no consequence.', 'What a coincidence.', 'You need only heed the call. Visit the Archaean and hear his plea. I can take you.', 'I\'m not one to stand on ceremony, but such an occasion calls for an introduction. Please, call me "Ardyn." Come with me to the car park. That\'s where I left my automobile. She\'s a dear old thing. Pales next to your Regalia, but she\'s never let me down. So we take two vehicles—a convoy of sorts. Shall we?', 'All set?', 'Allow me to do the honor of assigning your driver... I choose you!', 'You might find the cab fare to be more than you bargained for.', 'Come now, he always drives. Be a friend and let him rest for a change.', 'You might find the rental fees to be more than you bargained for.', 'You drive your car, and I drive mine. With that decided, let us be off.', "Just to be clear, this isn't a race, it is a chase. You're not to pass me. Lose sight of me, and you'll lose your way. And no tailgating. An accident would spoil the trip.", 'As you wish. Drive safely, now.', 'What say we call it a day here?', "The Archaean's not going anywhere.", "Oh, I'm afraid I've never really been one for the outdoors. I shall foot the bill, so let us stay at the caravan over yonder.", "Well, well, if it isn't yours truly.", "Oh, I don't mind at all! Snap away—for His Highness's collection.", 'Good morning to you!', "I should warn you: we're about to pass the point of no return. I trust you're not having any second thoughts?", "We're here.", 'Have I given you reason to doubt me?', "Hello! It's me! Be so kind as to open up!", "I may not look like much, but I do have some influence. Aren't you glad we came together? Your audience with divinity lies ahead.", "I drop you at the Archaean's open door, and with that, bid you farewell.", 'Fancy meeting you here!', 'It occurs to me I never formally introduced myself. Izunia. Ardyn Izunia.', 'At your service. And more importantly, to your aid.', "I guarantee your safe passage. Though you're always welcome to take your chances down there.", 'Buried among the rubble, is it?', 'Oh, thank the gods I found you boys.', 'Why, grant you safe passage—just as I said.', 'Come now. Is it fair to begrudge a man the circumstances of his birth?', "This instant? It's a long way down. Perhaps the army could break your fall. Or perhaps you could simply sit back and enjoy the ride. You needn't worry: you're in good hands with me.", "Here's hoping you find that car of yours.", "I'd say that's far enough. A hand, Highness?", "Oh, but I'm here to help.", 'By taking the army away.', "When next we meet, it'll be across the seas. Just so happens we have business of our own with the tutelary deity. Don't we?", 'Fare thee well, Your Majesty, and safe travels.', 'Gentlemen, what a pleasant surprise.', 'With my imperial friends, no less.', "But fear not—I'll put in a good word. Well, come along, then.", "Don't stray too far, lest you get left behind. And surely you'd rather avoid unnecessary scuffles, seeing as you're now a trio. Oh, dear. Touchy subject?", "Then let's discuss why you're here. Hmm... . It can't be archaeology... Mythril, perhaps?", "Mythril—it's a precious resource. We can't just let anyone get their hands on it.", 'I never said that!', "Where is the fun in that? I thought you'd rather dig it up yourselves.", "Fear not—I'll be but a moment.", 'All clear! Go ahead.', "Alas, the ever-wary military—they'll not abide visitors left unattended. I must prevail upon you to accept an escort. I've seen to everything.", "Oh, did I ever tell you I'm the chancellor?", 'But did you know the army and I are unaffiliated?', "It's true. I have no authority whatsoever. But what I lack in authority, I make up for in friends.", "I trust you'll be civil. Commodore Aranea Highwind, I leave them to you.", 'The wedding day arrives, but alas, without the bride.', "Of course, we've come for the Hydraean, and you've gone to such lengths to prepare.", 'Ah, but for an outsider to lead the imperial army must be a battle in and of itself.', "You've spoken to Lady Lunafreya?", "That obstinate secretary, standing in the way. While you rush off to slay the Hydraean for your poor sister's sake.", 'I know the price of the covenant.', 'Now, about that ring...', 'On second thought... You let him have it.', 'And do remind him about the Crystal.', 'Oh, Prince! Your bride awaits!', 'How sweet... But please, Lady Lunafreya, you first.', "It's a real mystery.", "I'm not liking that snow cloud. Kind of gives me the chills. Like, who comes up with this stuff? I couldn't dream something like this if I tried. It's a wondrous world.", "Whoa, what's going on!? Easy there, buddy. Didn't see that coming. You alright?", 'Be careful there! Wait—is this for real?', 'Uh... Noct?', "C'mon, Noct. You're scaring me! Seriously, man, cut it out!", "It's not safe. Plus, you're causing a scene. Quit playing around, okay?", 'Dude, are you seriously trying to kill me!?', 'What are you talking about? Do you really mean that, Noct?', "You won't even let me! Noct, please. Can't we talk for a sec?", 'Yes! What good would it do me to hurt you!?', "Noct, please. Can't we talk for a sec?", 'How long were you in the dark?', "Given the chancellor's involvement, it's probable he's no longer where we left him. In any case, he may try to contact us. Let us wait and hope for now.", "Oh, there you are! I'm worried about your friends. They've fallen and they can't get up. Why not lend them a hand?", 'A coldness that can only be hers.', "I feel I've earned the right to call you Noct. For a moment I felt death's chill wind, such is the might of the gods. But then, I remembered I'm immortal. Such is my blessing and curse. Your attack hurt me, nevertheless...", 'My feelings at least.', "And after all the memories we've shared. Remember this?", 'Ah, I should have asked if you remember him. Truly a blast from the past, nay?', "Ah, ah, ah! You mustn't take what's not yours.", '"He"?', "The little gunman's a short shot away.", "Where else but Gralea, the seat of the empire? I'm sure he'll be delighted to see you. And you might even find your Crystal. With all these daemons about, you could certainly use it.", "Off you go, then. I wouldn't want to keep you from your friend.", 'Look at you. All by your lonesome.', "How does it feel to be powerless? Can't help your friends if you can't help yourself.", "Can't you simply taste the air of foreboding?", 'Must be tiring, having to run all the time.', 'That magic is a royal disappointment.', "It's all coming along swimmingly, isn't it?", 'Poor Prompto must be feeling the heat right about now.', "Are you certain it wasn't the real thing? Wouldn't want to make a mistake.", "Oh, it's just so unfair!", "Your heart's desire, so close now. Soon it will be within your grasp. I suggest you take the central elevator. It will take you to your goal.", "Oh, now they've found you.", 'The higher you climb... ... the further you fall.', "Can't you simply taste the air of foreboding?", "Did you hear that? There's something out there...", "A-ha! Well, you can't say I didn't warn you.", "Oh, you're such a tease.", 'You really are helpless without your friends babysitting you.', 'I have grave doubts about your friends.', 'Tragedy could strike at any moment.', 'What was that noise? Is it scary being on your lonesome?', "I love surprises! Oh, you'll fall for anything.", "The empire made considerable inroads into the science of daemons. Well, after I showed them the way, of course. We'd managed to make daemons... right here.", "Ever wonder where daemons come from? Once upon a time, they were children of nature—beasts and men. Aw, and you've killed so many.", 'The infantry units you callously dub "MTs" all began as babes in this very facility. Imprinted with serial codes and incubated until they were strong enough to fight. What a pity. Innocent souls fated to suffer... at the hands of a foreign king. Well, not so "MT" after all, are they?', 'Oho! Well done, my boy.', 'The most fascinating tidbit about your dear Prompto...', 'How will this story end, I wonder.', "Where are your friends? You don't think (gasp) they ran off without you?", "You still haven't found Gladio? Only a matter of time before Ignis bumbles into a trap. You must feel very much alone right now.", "Your buddies have bright lives ahead of them. Don't take it personally if they choose their own over yours.", 'Not so tough without your borrowed toys, are you?', 'You really are helpless without your friends babysitting you.', 'Where does it hurt? You can tell me.', "In case there was any doubt: it's a trap.", 'A little pain never hurt anyone. On you go. Hurry. While you dawdle, people are dying.', 'Reunited with your retainers at last. How very touching. Must be a fine feeling, having friends. Look how happy you are! I pray you find your dear Prompto soon.', "Your Majesty, your precious Crystal awaits you. To liven things up I thought I'd take you on a stroll down memory lane. Of course, memories decay with time.", 'You could still get to the Crystal... if you went on your own. Your friends will have to stay behind.', "You'd better think fast. I don't envy you your decision.", 'Betraying your friends for the greater good—the mark of a monarch! Step forth, Your Majesty!', "If you wish to obtain the Crystal's power, you must be prepared to lose all else.", 'Do you suppose your dear friends are still alive? Those who died for you—do you ever wonder what went through their minds? Can you even recall their final words?', 'Your journey is over, Noct.', "Unharmed by the Light. The Chosen King, indeed. Allow me to regale you with a tale. In an age long past, an incurable scourge ravaged mankind. A tiny menace that twisted men into monsters, the likes of which you've seen. In Lucis lived a savior who could cure the afflicted. His body would come to host myriad daemons, that countless lives be spared. But a jealous king, one not yet chosen by the Crystal, ostracized and demonized this healer of the people. Making a true monster of him. I gave you my name earlier, but you should know that it was not the name given to me at birth. Ardyn Lucis Caelum is my proper name. You'll never guess whose name Izunia was. Noct, killing you as a mortal will bring me scant satisfaction. Claim the Crystal's power. Arise as its champion. Only once the Crystal and King are no more... can I know redemption. Come back soon. I shall keep your friends company until you are ready.", 'Perhaps I could be of service.', 'Why, I come bearing gifts.', 'See? Gifts! Now, I believe a "thank you" is in order.', "Here I am, helping for a change, but I can see I'm not wanted.", 'Right this way, gentlemen.', "Keep going... A little closer... Yes, that's a good boy.", "You tried to save the world in my stead, but it wasn't enough. The Crystal chose me—not you.", "Aw, rejection hurts, doesn't it?", "Ifrit, the Infernian. He doesn't share the Glacian's fondness for mankind. But you can expect a... warm welcome. I shall await you... above.", "I'm afraid you're out of luck. The throne brings you here? It seats only one.", 'Oh, Noct... How I have waited for this. Longer than you could ever know.', 'Tonight, the dreams of the blood royal... come to an end.', 'They have no place in this, the battle of kings! Come, Noctis!', "The once helpless and hapless prince. Is he now ready to claim his crown? Don't let us down.", 'Let it be done. Until only one remains.', 'So you are the Chosen King... ... but you are a second choice, at best.', "Do you like what I've done with the world? I twisted it all... just for you.", "Does it hurt? The pain is proof you're mortal!", 'Cutting it close!', 'How long must I wait!?', 'Where is your head?', 'Truly, a pity.', 'Over here.', 'The legend proved to be a myth.', 'Really!?', 'No more!', 'One step behind!', 'A gift for you!', 'And so it ends!', 'Let it be done!', 'Ah, terribly disappointing!', "Is that really the best you can do? Perhaps it's time you threw yourself on my mercy.", 'Even were the dawn to break now... ... it would only bring the horrors to light!', 'Behold, O King. This realm in darkness.', "Oh, yes, you'll be the very death of me.", 'Chosen, indeed. Chosen to die!', 'The ten years you spent accumulating your power... ... I spent assimilating daemons and accumulating mine.', "Let me know when you're ready to begin.", "Did I mention? I'm immortal.", 'I was so close... ... so very close to taking those friends of yours... ... and making them into daemons.', 'Ah... My revenge is soon at hand... How long have I waited... ?', "Well, let's have it, then. You and your Crystal... ... against all I have become.", 'Ahh, a king! At last!', 'A war... of attrition, then.', 'The Kings of Yore are on hand. Calling you forth... to oblivion.', 'Yet when your father died... ... you were off playing with your friends! When your beloved died... ... you lay watching, powerless to stop it! You think ten years is a long time!? It is nothing to me! I have lived in darkness for ages!', 'So, that is how you would end it.', 'Now it is over, Majesty.', 'What will you do?', 'Banish the daemons and bring peace? Erase me from history once more?', 'I will await you... in the beyond.', 'She still remembers you, after all these years.', "We can't have you spilling blood here.", 'Although to most this compound is known only as the First Magitek Production Facility, birthplace of the myriad magitek troopers and daemons the empire holds dear, toyou this place should have some sentimental value. After all, it is your home sweet home.', "I'm not the one who almost killed you.", 'You really ought to take a rest.', 'Perhaps the estimable Chief Besithia will help heal that broken heart of yours.', "Oh, how quickly they forget. But fear not: I've no doubt a reunion would refresh your memory.", 'My friend, do you recall the child who was stolen from this facility?', "Precisely. I thought you might like to see the fine young man he's become these twenty odd years later. So, as thanks for bringing your pets to Insomnia, I've brought the boy to you.", 'The time has come to meet your maker. Any questions for daddy dearest? Father and son! Oh, how I love bringing families together.', "Look what you've done. You've gone homicidal—no, patricidal!", "You lose your friends and murder your family. Now you've no one left!"]

Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ['Gather strength, O Chosen. The fate of this world falls to the King of Kings, His Providence consecrated in the divine Light of the Crystal. So it is ordained—the revelation of Bahamut.', 'They stand against the darkness and abide in hope, sustained by faith unfaltering that their King shall arise and bring deliverance.', "A man cursed with life eternal, whose immortality stems from the selfsame scourge that wrought the daemons. One so impure of body and soul was deemed unworthy of the Crystal's Light, and forbidden to ascend. His mind twisted by spite and bent on revenge, the Usuper came to bring darkness down upon our world. Only the True King, chosen by the Crystal and guarded by his forebears, can end the Accursed's madness.", "It is the sole means to ending the immortal Accursed. A power greater than even that of the Six, purifying all by the Light of the Crystal and the glaives of rulers past. Only at the throne can the Chosen receive it, and only at the cost of a life: his own. The King of Kings shall be granted the power to banish the darkness, but the blood price must be paid. To cast out the Usurper and usher in dawn's light will cost the life of the Chosen. Many sacrificed all for the King; so must the King sacrifice himself for all.", 'Now enter into Reflection, that the Light of Providence shine within.', 'The Light waxes full. Go forth to the kingdom, where the Usurper awaits. Reclaim the throne, and fulfill the calling of the True King.']

Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ['You got it, Lady A!', 'You got it, Lady A!', "Only if we have to. What's all this about?", 'That all?', 'You got us there.', "We're happy to help. Can't say the climate will be as cooperative, though. Y'know?", "The place is freezin'! Makes sense, what with the ice goddess's cold corpse lyin' around. It's a rather long ride, so I suggest you bundle up before we ship out. By the way, I bumped into a woman from the manor, used to serve House Fleuret. Must've gone off looking for ya. Said she had something important to discuss.", "The only way we could help the people was by leaving the army. Lady A'd about had it with them as it were.", 'Aranea, the Commodore.', "Nothing but daemons in the capital. Meanwhile, the Crystal's just sitting there. No one in the army signed up for this!", "They're either lying quiet behind closed doors or lying dead. Your guess is as good as mine.", "Ready to depart. Just swapped out the damaged cars for some new ones. Give one of us a holler when you're ready to shove off, then.", 'Shall we shove off, then?', "Oi! Uh—attention all passengers! We're on our way to our final destination in the imperial capital. Enjoy the ride. I'll be in touch if anything comes up.", 'Attention, eh!', "You may have noticed we've stopped. As for the cause... Outside, ya think?", 'Oh. Well.', "City's trying to keep us out... with the daemons.", "Gotta run! Don't worry about us."]

Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ["The insolence of that up-jumped mercenary... And there is still no word. This cannot be borne. Such behavior besmirches His Radiance's good name.", "What is that chancellor playing at? I'm no man's fool. He sent Highwind to watch me.", 'It\'s no mere coincidence she and I meet wherever I go. Claims to "trust her as a person." Hollow words from the mind behind the magitek movement.', "I may have acted in haste with that impudent steward back in Lestallum, but my mission remains clear. And I'll be damned if that mercenary gets her grubby hands on the prince before Caligo Ulldor.", "I'll give Highwind one last chance to respond. Stand guard here. If the commodore arrives, send her through.", 'You were foolish to come here. Surrender now, or we will make you wish you had.', 'You led us all on a merry chase, but your running days are over. Have at them! Take the prince alive!', 'You humiliated me before. This time the pleasure will be mine.', 'An unexpected outcome.']

Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ['I heard about your distinguished guests.', "Gentlemen, I won't waste your time. My name is Camelia Claustra.", 'You should know we have Lady Lunafreya in our care. And the empire demands we surrender her.', "Yet I am loath to acquiesce unless we stand to profit. Hence I've come to discuss terms... with the King of Lucis. If you've a mind to talk, come to my estate.", 'Thank you for coming.', "It's the least I could do for a king. Weskham didn't extend me an invitation, so I decided to extend my own. Though circumstances have changed, both the king and the Oracle are finally in Altissia.", "He didn't even tell me you were here. Fortunately, I have my own ways of finding out. Though circumstances have changed, both the king and the Oracle are finally in Altissia.", 'If you want gossip, go to a café. I, for one, am here for business. Though circumstances have changed, both the king and the Oracle are finally in Altissia.', "Is the king concerned for our relations with the empire? But it's true, the Oracle is a risk—one we are prepared to shed with. Whether we do so depends on you. Now, let me ask some questions of my own. Why does the Oracle seek to awaken the Hydraean?", 'She is. But whether she remains so depends wholly upon you. Now, let me ask some questions of my own. Why does the Oracle seek to awaken the Hydraean?', 'So hasty. Surely you can spare a moment to talk. Now, let me ask some questions of my own. Why does the Oracle seek to awaken the Hydraean?', "The answer I wanted to hear. And yet, king or not, it can't be a simple affair for you to receive a god's blessing. Let me be frank: the potential chaos worries me. You know better than most what took place in Lucis with the Archaean. Tell me, what happened?", 'She would wake a slumbering goddess just to have a chat? Somehow I doubt the Tidemother will take kindly to being roused on a mortal whim. Let me be frank: the potential chaos worries me. You know better than most what took place in Lucis with the Archaean. Tell me, what happened?', 'So the Oracle can do as she pleases? A precarious attitude to take before a god. Let me be frank: the potential chaos worries me. You know better than most what took place in Lucis with the Archaean. Tell me, what happened?', "Just like the legends. Though the empire doesn't like the way the story goes. Even as we speak, they mobilize their forces. It seems there's no avoiding chaos. It will most likely come to war. However, I don't care to host a battle on my soil, the gods and the empire be damned.", "Really? A mild way to put it. It will most likely come to war. However, I don't care to host a battle on my soil, the gods and the empire be damned.", 'An intriguing suggestion...', "Very sharp, Your Majesty. But before we go into that, there is one matter I'd like to settle. Without further ado, let us talk terms. If you wish to hold the rite, you must ensure my citizens' safety and aid in their evacuation.", "Not all of them—I'm not so naïve as that. There are things that you must do for yourself. If you wish to hold the rite, you must ensure my citizens' safety and aid in their evacuation.", "Nothing of worth to contribute? Without further ado, let us talk terms. If you wish to hold the rite, you must ensure my citizens' safety and aid in their evacuation.", "I'm pleased to hear it. As long as the people's safety is assured, I have no qualms with your rite. You are on your own.', "In a manner of speaking. But to rephrase it from our perspective, Accordo has no troops that can aid you. Not amid such chaos, at any rate. That is all for the terms. I'm sorry we cannot do more, but as I'm sure you are aware, few armies can stand against the might of the imperial fleet. That is all for the terms. That is all for the terms. To review, you are to ensure our citizens' safety and engage the empire. Do we have an agreement?", "Allies? Such a vote of confidence. Well, you can trust us to do our part to do our part and keep the Oracle safe. A final warning, though I doubt it'll come to it. My duty is to my citizens. Should any harm befall them, there will be a reckoning—for both king and Oracle.", "Lest you forget, this is a business deal. A flippant attitude will earn you a flippant response. A final warning, though I doubt it'll come to it. My duty is to my citizens. Should any harm befall them, there will be a reckoning—for both king and Oracle.", "Hmph. A final warning, though I doubt it'll come to it. My duty is to my citizens. Should any harm befall them, there will be a reckoning—for both king and Oracle.", "You're just like your father.", "You've made the right decision.", 'I look forward to working with the new king.', "Sometimes I can't tell whether you're sharp or dull.", 'A leader must know when to bring out the steel. Surely you understand this.', 'Yet "getting" is not the same as accepting.', 'Still so young, and still so much to learn.', "Again you intrigue me. You and your father are cut from different cloths. I wonder what manner of king you'll make.", "Interest doesn't into it. You'll see.", 'You understand what I must do. I will stop at nothing to protect my people.', "A difficult choice, I know. But if you try to protect everything, you'll end up protecting nothing.", 'Assign three of your own for the evacuation effort. Whom you choose is up to you. According to our intel, the imperial fleet will be four warships strong. Steel yourselves for a full-scale battle.', "This meeting didn't instill me with confidence, be we must make do.", 'I trust you understand your part in this? What happens next is up to you.', "I'm glad we could talk. We can each act in our own interest to our mutual benefit.", "I can't promise something I can't help.", "What can I say? I have a soft spot for the young and tragic. They've lost Regis, they've lost the Crystal... Was it so long ago the last Oracle was taken from them? We've seen the empire go mad these ten-odd years.", "If worse comes to worst, you can threaten to throw the trident into the sea. Then they'll listen. In the meantime, it will be well guarded. Better than the Oracle herself.", "Remember: you'll be under imperial watch.", 'Think of it as a necessary evil in order to forge the covenant.', "Once it's over, you may go as you please. But you do so without our protection.", 'You had better get going.']

Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ["Roll ‘er in while I'm still young!", "Didn't yer daddy tell ya? She's a custom classic, not some beat-up ol' clunker.", 'Prince Noctis.', '"Prince." Like they took your old man and kicked the dignity out of him.', "You got a long way to go, son. And that slack jaw's gettin' you nowhere fast. She's gonna take a while. Y'all get her in and run along.", "Crystal and the king's ring—what they been after all along...", "Don't kid yourself. Reggie wasn't born yesterday. Lucis got dealt a losin' hand, and your old man played it the best he could. He saw this comin' a mile away, and he wasn't gonna go down without a fight. In the end, though... Well, it just wasn't enough.", "You need something else, you talk to Cor. I can't even remember the last time I saw Reggie. Feels like a lifetime ago.", "Cor left a message, said he'll wait for ya in the tombs. They're to the northwest of here, just a short ways past the outpost. Find that first.", "Interestin' toy you got there.", "Well, I'll be, Crown City-made. If ya like, I can make this puppy better, give it more oomph.", 'I can mod it for you.', "Look, I got diddly-squat to do, what with Cindy takin' care of the garage. If you can find the parts, I can do the work for ya.", "Received with thanks. Y'all jus' leave the rest to me.", "Whoa, Niff-make this time? Is there nothin' you lot won't pick up? Anyhoo, show me the parts, an' I'll show you serious firepower.", "Lemme tell ya, imperial hardware is a right pain to take apart. Ain't no mystery I can't unravel, though.", 'Here she is, yer weapon reborn.', "Gotta say, that's a right old piece you managed to find. Musta been thirty-odd years ago when they was in service over in Crown City.", "Findin' the right tools for these relics took it outta me.", "Ah, but while rummagin' through my stuff, an interestin' item turned up. Go on, take it.", "A lil' somethin' I had loaned to yer old man, during our trip way back when. Reggie loved it so much, he'd find every chance he could to help me out with it. But when it came time for him to give it back, he scratched some nonsense into it.", "Always irked me, so it's fittin' I dump it on the son.", "Ain't nothin' nobody could've done to stop what happened.", 'But you need to realize just what you mean to the boys by your side.', "Even if they can't solve your problems, you can't hide what's goin' on from 'em. It hurts like hell. Remember—those ain't your bodyguards, they're your brothers. Trust in 'em. Always.", "Waitin' for an invitation? Get your asses on board!", "So, soon you'll have yer old man's ring back.", 'Good thing. To him, it was his heritage.', "Carrying a royal line ain't a task to be taken lightly. For a small thing, that ring can sure weigh heavy. After he became king, I only ever saw his face in the paper.", 'Nah, I was long gone from the city.', "Had a fallin' out o' sorts with your old man. Right at the end of the trip.", "We buried the hatchet years later, but never talked face to face again. Shoulda paid a visit while I had the chance. Well, no use dwellin' on it now. Got the Regalia in the hold, but y'all gonna stay in Altissia for a good while, right?", "In that case, I'll tune her up for y'all. Not that I'll have much to do, though, what with Cindy lookin' after the old girl.", "She was never afraid o' hard work. Heaven knows she had a hard childhood.", "Lost 'em both when she was little. Was big enough to understand, though... an' to hurt. But ya wouldn't guess that, seein' her now.", "Well, that oughta tell ya how far she's come.", 'Yeah... Only done been the once. Stayed a good while, though.', "Big ol' city.", "Well, it ain't the Crown City.", "Change o' scenery oughta do you good.", "We'll be there in no time. Nice having the wind at our backs.", "Ain't no hotel, but I know a fella has a place.", 'Weskham—ran with Reggie and me way back when.', "Yep. Runs himself a diner or café or somethin'. Go and see for yourselves.", '"Magee"? Or "Magoo"? Or—"Maagho," that\'s the one.', "You can count on ol' Wes. He'll chew your ears off.", 'Lord knows—this world could use some wisdom.', 'Relax. I got one.', 'Here.', 'You could say that. Thirty-odd years ago.', 'Lucky us, eh?', "Hey, didn't we just— Well, we're here to visit a... a joint. Maagho. Maagho's the name. Yeah.", 'Ugh, what a racket. This is your trip—you cough up the cash.', 'Fancy rooms were never my style.', "Managed to stay fed all these years. Not gonna starve to death now. An' ol' Wes'll see that I don't go thirsty either.", "Why're you dawdlin' here? Go on, git!", 'What/ Already done your business?', "Don't ya have better things to do?", "How in tarnation's a man supposed to get any work done when his tools're flyin' off the shelves all will-nilly!?", "In all my years livin' on the outside, I ain't never felt anythin' like these earthquakes. Ain't good for nothin' but givin' me a backache!", "You boys took down the adamantoise!? Reggie wrassled with that ol' fella back in the day, an' now you've finished the job."]

Wouldn't want ya to ruin your royal reputation.", "Hey, it's Cindy. How goes the huntin'?", "That's great, 'cause I got one more hunt for ya'll—only this time it's for a person. Fella named Dave went off, and we ain't heard from him since. Reckon he staked out a spot in an old shack nearby.", "Hey! Dave just called an' said he's safe. Thanks for findin' him.", "Nice work, y'all. By the way, the old girl's looking good as new. She'll be waiting at the garage.", "Oh! While I got ya, if y'all wanna fix ‘er up before ya roll out, let me know.", "She'll be waiting at the garage.", "Sorry 'bout the wait. Ain't she purdy?", "All the more reason to ride with care.
