You're gonna love it—promise!", "Well, here she is! Now y'all won't need to pay the roads no nevermind. After all, limits were only made to be broken.", 'That the prince I see?', "Just on one of my early mornin' hikes. Girl's gotta stay fit, y'know! Ain't it beautiful up here? One of my favorite spots. What're y'all doin' here?", "Well, I'll be. Couple of early birds, ain't ya?", "Fancy that. What're ya snappin' today, Mr. Cameraman?", "Um. Didn't quite catch that. Anyhow, I'd better skedaddle. See y'all later!", "Paw-paw!? That sounds funnier'n a moogle in a chocobo race. Lemme see!", "That's a mighty fine idea!", "How 'bout that. Betcha she looks real purdy with the mornin' sun glistenin' off that chrome. Well, I'd better mosey on back before Paw-paw gets too ornery. Come 'round and show me your pictures sometime!", "Swell. Don't be a stranger now.", "Um. Didn't quite catch that. Anyhow, I'd better skedaddle. See y'all later!", "Um. Didn't quite catch that. Anyhow, I'd better skedaddle. See y'all later!", "Glad y'all made it. No weather for drivin', that's for sure.", "Left to see to business, and left y'all a message with Paw-paw.", "Boss ain't sat still one second since he heard y'all were comin'.", "Y'all keep on keepin' on, now.", "Ain't never seen Paw-paw like this before. The pep's gone out of him like air from a tire.", "Oh! Hey there! Prince! Howdy, y'all! Howdy there, Prince! Are y'all on break?", "Don't you worry. This girl ain't got nothin' up her sleeves this time.", "Most days that's true, but today's a little different. I was just about to step away from the garage for a spell. One of our regulars told me they found somethin' real special lyin' around: a rare can of car wax. Reckon y'all could use it on the Regalia, so I'm on my way to pick it up.", "Y'sure?", "I tell you what, you got a point there. Well, if y'all insist, who am I to argue? Might take a little while to find it though.", "Fella found it, but didn't have the foresight to grab it.", "If y'all hadn't agreed to help, I reckon I woulda had to ask the Hunters to lend a hand!", "They stopped sellin' the stuff some thirty-odd years ago. It'll last a lifetime—which is probably how long it'll be 'til they make any more.", "Ain't every day you run across wax of this quality. Wouldn't wanna pass up a once-in-a-lifetime chance, would ya?", "Ya found it! Well, I'll be. And it's still in purdy good condition, too. Slap some of this wax on your car, and y'all'll be glidin' down the road and saving gas, too.", "Don't go believin' it outta hand, though. That's just what the rumors say, among a bunch of other things. Still, in every rumor, there's a grain of truth. After all, when it comes to cars, Crown City folk know their business. It's a right shame they put up the Wall thirty years ago. Lotta goods became the stuff of legend—including this wax.", "Paw paw left the city and never looked back, so I've only ever come across what he had lyin' around the garage. But now that we got ourselves a can, why don't we crack ‘er open and put those rumors to the test? Let me know if ya want me to give ya a hand with the waxin'.", "Look who it is. Y'all takin' the day off?", "Aw, ain't y'all sweet. Don't you worry about li'l ol' me. I got a lot to do, but I can fend for myself.", "Hmmm... Alright. If y'all wouldn't mind fetchin' me some ore, I'll fix ya up with somethin' real nice like!", "You can make some real purdy mineral paints with the right stones. Sometimes we even have 'em treated and use 'em in car parts!", "Sadly, this ore ain't for you. Sorry, y'all. But I promise I'll give ya somethin' I think you'll really like!", "Thanks for the help, Prince! Have y'all considered becomin' hunters full-time? Let's see. This here's for paint, that one's goin' for treatment... Oh, shoot—I gotta phone Holly. Welp, looks like another sleepless night!", "Got a few folks waitin' on repairs, so duty calls. Anyhoo, as promised, here's your reward! You can slap that decal right on the Regalia. Try ‘er out!", 'Hey, Prince. Could I borrow you for a sec?', "You're gonna ask me that every time, ain't ya? But as it were, I was hopin' you might find somethin' for me.", "And which of y'all would that be? Anyhoo, I need y'all to fetch me some fiberglass coating. I asked a hunter to bring some back, but wouldn't ya know it? Fella took a break somewhere an' left it behind. Funny thing is, I ordered it with you boys in mind. If y'all go fetch it for me, I'll throw it on the Regalia for ya.", "Hunters lead a busy life. These days, they're so swamped with takin' care of varmints and daemons that they sometimes forget the little requests.", 'Welcome back! Ya find the place alright?', "No surprise there. Y'all can hang onto that—that's your reward. Spray your car with a coat of that stuff, and it'll keep ‘er lookin' spic-an'-span! Y'all wanna treat the old girl right, don't ya? And nothing feels better than driving around in a clean car.", 'Well, hey there, Prince!', 'You guessed it. Must be written all over my face. Y\'see, one of our regulars tipped me off to somethin\' real special. Little thing called a "supercharger"—and a purdy powerful one, at that. You boys wouldn\'t happen to be innerested in one, would ya? Fella snatched it from a scrap car, but didn\'t know what to do with it, so he left it. If y\'all want it, it\'s yours for the taking.', "Used to be able to get around at night if ya had a set of wheels, but less folks have 'em nowadays, since drivin' sets off the daemons.", "Some folks scavenge old clunkers for scraps, but ain't anyone who can use 'em anymore. Lotta good parts goin' to waste these days.", "Breaks a girl's heart to see the roads around here so empty. Times sure are a changin', ain't they? Guess I've just gotta get with 'em.", "How'd it go? Did y'all find it?", "That's swell! I already checked with Paw-paw. We can install that baby whenever you like. Can't wait to soup ‘er up and get ‘er runnin'. I bet y'all're really gonna feel a difference! Just gimme a holler when you're ready to go.", 'Hey, Prince. Got a little favor.', "I was hopin' to fix the older girl up with a new set of eyes. Y'know, headlight bulbs.", "Might not sound like much, but believe you me, these babies'll brighten up your road trip. Woulda been nice if they were mass-produced. Crown City-made's hard to come by. Ain't barely none left out here.", "Ah, I didn't mean to bring up a sore subject. All I mean is it's a shame there ain't more around 'cause they really are gonna change the way you drive. Now I ain't gonna lie, going to fetch 'em will be a bit of a hassle. But I swear, you and your car will be better off with 'em. The old girl's designed to keep y'all safe, and these lights'll help ‘er keep you even safer. Do it for me?", "There y'all are! Well—did ya find 'em?", "Ya do? Oh, thank the Stars. Now, whether you keep usin' em is up to you, but humor me an' give 'em a test run first, won't ya?", "The bulbs pack a punch. The light they shine's so bright, it'll have the daemons headin' for the hills!", "Sure is. Woulda been nice if everybody had 'em before the city got walled off. Was about twenty years ago... Car runnin' through these parts one night... all of a sudden the daemons jumped it... Saw it with my own eyes. Can't never forget it. And I can't help thinkin', if they had these lights, they'd still be alive. Y'know?", "Anyhoo, lemme know when you wanna give 'em a try. And thanks for all your hard work, y'all.", 'Hey, Highness. About your car...', "Well, I found her, but she's at a base.", "Now, I can handle garage folk no problem, but sweet-talkin' the empire? That'll take some doing.", 'Yeah?', 'You sure about that?', "Knew it was y'all! Recognize the purr of that engine anywhere!", "Paw-paw's tinkerin' away. Reckon he'll be tinkerin' for some time.", "Seen her share, by the looks of her. Some parts we can fix, others need replacin'.", "Don't y'all worry. Paw-paw ain't goin' nowhere 'til the job's done. Parts won't fetch 'emselves, though. Was kinda hopin' y'all wouldn't mind helpin' out with that?", "To tell the truth, we already got a couple hands on deck: Dustin an' Monica.", 'Trouble is, they ain\'t had much like findin\' a certain somethin\' by the name of "mythril." Apparently the stuff\'s hard to come by around these parts, least accordin\' to the little fella from the city.', "You betcha! Sharp as a tack, that one. Could tell y'all more about the stuff'n I could.", "Paw-paw's down on the dock. Now, if y'all'd excuse me, I'm gonna grab my tools and skedaddle. Got a garage to look after.", "Howdy, Prince. D'you mind swingin' by the garage for a hot minute? We been experiencin' some awful strange shakes back here in Leide. The Hunters're already lookin' into it, but I reckon they could use a couple more hands.", "Howdy, Prince. D'you mind swingin' by the garage for a hot minute? We been experiencin' some awful strange shakes back here in Leide. The Hunters're already lookin' into it, but I reckon they could use a couple more hands.", "Some sizable seismic activity down south near Longwythe. Dave an' his boys are on the beat as we speak. It's the darndest thing. Ain't never felt so much as a rumble 'round these parts. Got a lotta folks worried. Got me worried, too. Aint' easy tunin' up a shakin' chassis. Anyhoo, hope Dave and y'all can do somethin'.", "Well, ain't you a sight for sore eyes! What's that ya got there?", "Bet yer britches I can. Y'all musta traveled around the world an' back again if ya managed to get your hands on one of those. Okay! Give me a little alone time with the ol' girl. Once I install this baby in ‘er, y'all ain't gonna recognize her.", "Off you go now! I reckon you'll be seein' the world from a brand new point-a-view.", "Howdy, y'all!", 'They also happen to be my favorite customers.', "Me an' Holly? We're bosom buddies.", "Y'all are showin' me a whole ‘nother side of yourselves!", "Y'see all of them takin' that Leap of Faith? I could never.", "Y'alright?", "You're funnier than Cactuars in a barrel.", "Hey, Prince! Somethin' the matter?", 'Sure do.', 'Alrighty then. If you say so.', "They're fixin' to find you, Your Highness.", 'Wish I knew. Holly said they\'re tryna set up a "secret weapon" at the plant, but she ain\'t havin\' none of it.', "Keep ‘er safe for me, y'hear?", 'Is there anything I can do?', "But my friend's in harm's way right now! I wanna do whatever I can to help.", "Make sure she's okay.", 'Poor Holly...', 'Take care.', "I'm gonna shut down that contraption.", "It ain't my first time at the rodeo. I know my way around the plant and the gizmos inside. My best friend's in trouble. I can't just sit around twiddlin' my thumbs when I could be out there helpin' her.", "Make sure she's okay.", 'Over here!', "You bet. Let's mosey!", 'Well, keep an eye out for me, will ya?', 'Thanks, boys. You really saved the day!', "Shucks, it was nothin'. I'm just glad Holly made it back right as rain.", "Now we ain't got nothin' to worry 'bout but havin' fun!", "A gift? For me? These are mighty hard to come by, y'know. I was startin' to think they were the stuff of legends. I'd be glad to take it off your hands, but is there anything I can do to repay you?", "I'd hardly call that a trade, but you got yourself a deal."]

Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ["That the best pick-up line you've got?", "I'm only teasing. I have a feeling I know the feline you've got in mind. Let me whip something up. Paying customers come first, though, and someone just ordered the last fish on hand. Would you mind catching another one of these while I make their meal?", "Great! I'll start on it right away. Y'know, this is really thoughtful of you, but be warned: cats are clingy, and they're notoriously picky eaters, too.", 'When it comes to food, felines are quite finicky—so you were wise to entrust the cooking to me. Here.', "My favorite hunters. You couldn't have come at a better time.", 'Indeed. And this time my request is as a purveyor of food, not info. I need an ingredient from Tenebrae.', "It's for a new confection I'm adding to our menu. I had actually planned to do so a while ago, in honor of your marriage to Lady Lunafreya. But with all that's happened, I held off on it.", "The ingredient's quite rare in Lucis, but I'm hopeful that you can track it down.", "It's a fine dessert. Would be a shame if it never had a chance to grace tables.", "And there's the special meaning it harbors by marrying Lucian and Tenebraean ingredients.", 'When it finally debuts, I want you to be the first to try it.', 'Thank you! With this, I can finally make the sweet.', "Right now. The prep is done. All that's left is the berry on the cake. You'll find the fragrance quite sublime. Why, I still remember the first time I smelled it. Let me know when you're ready to dine. And here, take this as a small token of my gratitude.", "Well, I guess my cover's blown. I didn't come here to cook—I came here as an informant.", "Thought about picking up some ingredients while I was in the area, but now's not really the time for grocery shopping. If the quakes shake the quay and our ships stop sailing, our restaurant's sunk. We need to solve this now.", "Oh, hello there. Thanks to you, my kitchen's safe. But tell me, did the adamantoise seem... edible?"]

Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ['So, you made it.', 'Where are you?', 'Makes sense.', "Listen. I'm heading out to Hammerhead. About the king... it's true.", "If you're looking for the whole truth, you know where to find me. Get moving.", 'At last, Your Highness.', "The power of kings, passed from the old to the new through the bonding of souls. One such soul lies before you. To claim your forebears' power is your birthright and duty as king.", 'Now is not the time to question your calling. A king is sworn to protect his people.', 'How long will you remain the protected? The king entrusted the role of protector to you.', "That day, he didn't want you to remember him as the king. In what time you had left, he wanted to be your father. He always had faith in you, that when the time came, you would ascend for the sake of your people.", "That's not the only power your forebears left you. Your journey's just begun. Another tomb lies close by. I suggest you head there next. There are tombs scattered across the land. All are on dangerous ground. I'll go with you, for the time being. Not only to help, but to get a measure of your strength.", "There are thirteen known royal arms, each enshrined at a royal tomb, though we know the location of only a few. I've enlisted the Hunters. They comb the land in search of the lost tombs.", 'Keycatrich Trench. We know there to be a crypt deep inside the tunnels.', "Don't get too full of yourselves over that.", "Hmph. You're not as sloppy as you look.", "Don't let your guard down!", "No, this shouldn't require much strategy.", "That wasn't a bad effort, Prompto.", "Don't take that as leave to slack off. You're only as good as your last battle.", "What's the plan, Ignis?", 'Well done, men!', 'Long years ago, we waged a fierce battle here against the empire. It all went to ruin, and after that, the empire moved in like it owned the place.', "Take 'em head on, or sneak up from behind. The choice is yours.", 'Prompto, you okay?', "Think you're up to it? Let's see what you can do.", "No wimping out. Let's move.", 'No slacking off, Gladio.', 'You alright, Highness?', 'No problem.', "Impressive. Not bad. You've come a long way.", "Here's where we go our separate ways. Take this key. It unlocks the doors to the other tombs.", "Seek them out and lay claim to the power they hold. You'll need it.", "Keep an eye on the Niffs. Find out what they're up to. But you should focus on your own task.", "Finally picked up. Thought I'd lost another king.", "Good to hear. I have a task for you. The empire's begun construction of a new base, along the road west to Duscae. I need you to put it out of commission. If left unchecked, it will cost us access to the west—and all the royal tombs that lie beyond. I believe you've met Monica. She can fill you in on the details. Go see her.", "Once we're in, we launch our ambush, pushing out while support pushes in, crushing the enemy from both sides.", 'Oughta be easy for you.', 'Remember, a king fights with dignity.', 'Thanks to you we were spared their attention.', "No wimping out. Let's move.", "Impressive. Seeing you in action puts my mind at ease. It's clear I don't need to worry any more. I'll return to watching the Niffs. ‘Til next time, take care.", 'Something I gotta get off my chest.', "I'm sorry. Sorry I wasn't there for your father. I swore an oath to protect the king, but I wasn't strong enough to uphold it.", 'You can never have too many tools. Here—learn to wield not only weapons, but magic as well.', "Just remember: it's a destructive force that doesn't discriminate. I suggest putting someone in charge of it.", 'Gladio?', 'Catch you at a bad time?', "Yeah, I'm at the Crow's Nest.", 'Sure.', 'What about you? Are you mentally prepared?', '‘Bout time.', "Allow me to ask you once more: are you sure you're ready to take on the Blademaster?", 'Then answer my question: are you ready or not?', "So you're ready to face death?", "Gilgamesh awaits challengers in the deepest recesses of those ruins. It's been thirty years since we uncovered the caves. We've sent countless expeditions, but all of our efforts have afforded us no rewards... ... and no survivors.", 'Barely.', "Let's move.", 'Did you tell your friends why you were taking off?', 'Or knowing your pride took a beating.', 'Not for long!', "The Blademaster's men have sworn their loyalty both before and beyond the grave, scaring off the unworthy.", 'In that case, let the trials begin.', "He's a master of blades. What—were you expecting something profound?", "The Blademaster isn't here to train you; he's here to test you. He won't go easy on you just because you joined the Crownsguard.", "In his eyes, the weak aren't worthy of living. All of them are fools, punished for aspiring beyond their station. I was a fool back then, too—and I was punished.", "Maybe he did, maybe he didn't.", "But don't forget it.", 'Keep your eyes and ears open.', 'Just like I taught you. Ready?', 'A trial chamber. The hand-holding stops here—good luck.', 'Well, you made it out alive. Your first trial may have ended, but many more await you on your road to an audience with the Blademaster. Prepare yourself.', 'No. You wanna know why?', "Not of the Trial. He was scared of failing as leader of the Crownsguard—and as Shield of the King. He couldn't leave His Majesty alone, weakened by the Wall as he was. After all, what good is a Shield with no one to protect? What about you? Worried about leaving Your Majesty alone?", 'Like father, like son.', "Give or take. I was a lot younger than you are—and far less experienced. It's a wonder I even made it out alive.", 'Vaguely. The younger me had little mind for taking in the sights.', "And another chance for the warriors to impart their wisdom. It won't come easy, though—you'll have to earn it.", 'Look at the bright side: everyone loves an underdog.', "Never thought I'd make my way back to the Tempering Grounds.", "If you wanna know, I'll talk.", "I don't remember much... except for those eyes. They pierced my heart and peered right into my soul. It was like he knew my every move even before I did. Try as you may, there's no fooling those eyes.", 'Some stories are better left untold.', "The penultimate trial awaits. Prove to them you're prepared to serve as the Shield of the Chosen King.", "Nice work. Maybe you've got what it takes after all.", "True—and the Blademaster is a more formidable foe than any you've faced thus far.", 'You that interested in me?', 'And a lot brasher too, if you can believe it. Wouldn\'t listen to a single word anyone said. I thought I was invincible. No one could stop me... until he cut me down to size. I was cast out in defeat, my hubris laid bare for all to see. "You really are immortal," they said—and it stuck.', 'It would be my pleasure.', "That guy must've left quite an impression... ... when he landed flat on his face.", "Clarus would've tried to stop you, you know—just like he tried to stop me all those years ago.", "Because one aspiring to the role of King's Shield can stake his life for none but his liege—not even for himself.", '"Do you dare risk all for naught in return?" His words stayed with me. And he was right: I barely made it back with nothing to show for it.', "No, I won't. But I will warn you one last time of the danger you're about to face—just like your father warned me. Once you set foot through that door, there's no turning back—and no one to help you if you fall. One false step, and it may prove your last.", 'Just come back alive. Be safe, Gladio.', 'You made it.', "And so quickly. I'm impressed.", 'I wondered where I put that thing.', 'Keep it. Makes for a better souvenir than that scar.', 'That so?', 'Takes more than will to complete the trial. You need to wield your weapon with a primal finesse. If you fail to prove your might, you get cast out empty-handed.', 'Gladio.', 'I hope you feel more confident in light of your success today. Few men can lay claim to such an accomplishment—not even Cor the Immortal.', 'Good.', "Congratulations, Gladio. You accomplished that which I couldn't. Care to show this failure how it's done?", 'Not on my watch. Ready?', 'At ease. Thus ends your final "trial." You did Clarus proud today. Now go. Walk tall as the Shield of the Chosen King.']

Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ["Hey, who's out there?", "Didn't mean to cause y'all any trouble. Been stuck here on account of my sprained ankle. Somethin' funny 'bout them varmints. I gave 'em hell, but couldn't finish the job. Still one mean mutt about. Y'all don't look much like hunters, but whaddaya say? Put that puppy to rest for me?", "Y'all got guts, that's for sure. Lemme tell ya where I last saw him.", "Y'all got guts, that's for sure. Lemme tell ya where I last saw him.", "Y'all got guts, that's for sure. Lemme tell ya where I last saw him.", "I've been huntin' for years, but I ain't never seen dualhorns with blood-red tusks like those.", "Wonder if the nights growin' longer's got anything to do with 'em showin' up outta the blue...", 'Well, whatever it is, we oughta take it out before it can spawn any more like it.', 'Well, look who it is. I really owe you boys one.', "Can't seem to catch a break.", 'Looks like they found another one.', "Tag. Us hunters keep 'em on our person at all times as identification.", "Hunters lead a life of danger, and sometimes these tags are the only thing that makes it back in one piece. It's our job to deliver 'em to the families of the fallen. As it were, I came out here to do just that. If y'all happen to find any tags lyin' around out there, could ya do me a favor and send 'em my way?", "Word is somebody spotted a tag 'round these parts. Try askin' the local tipster; he'll point ya in the right direction.", 'Like I always tell my hunters, "Knowledge is power that\'ll save your ass." Stay informed. Might save your ass someday, too.', "Never got a chance to properly express my gratitude for the other day. Thanks for bailin' me outta there.", "Lotta folks think they gotta be tough to be the best hunter, but the best hunters are the ones who know when they ain't tough enough.", 'Found one already, huh? Ya done good.', "Well, try to keep your spirits up. Even though I ain't one to talk. I beat myself up over the lives of the hunters I couldn't save. That's what each one of these tags means to me. They hurt. But if I let that grief keep me from lookin' for 'em, then their tags and their lives'll be forgotten forever. And that'd hurt more than anything.", "That's why I tell all my hunters to collect any tag they see—and I expect you boys to go out and do the same.", "We meet again. You stickin' around these parts for a spell? Could use your help diggin' up some dog tags.", "Howdy. Just heard word of another lost tag. Don't know where you boys are headed, but would y'all mind pickin' it up if it's on your way?", "Howdy, boys. If y'all happen to stumble across another tag out there in the field, do me a favor and bring it my way.", "Howdy, boys. Say, if you could take a little time out, would you mind helpin' me track down some more tags?", "We meet again. You stickin' around these parts for a spell? Could use your help diggin' up some dog tags.", "Howdy. Just heard word of another lost tag. Don't know where you boys are headed, but would y'all mind pickin' it up if it's on your way?", "Howdy, boys. If y'all happen to stumble across another tag out there in the field, do me a favor and bring it my way.", "Howdy, boys. Say, if you could take a little time out, would you mind helpin' me track down some more tags?", "Boys. Still huntin' the good hunt?", "Been keepin' hard at it?", 'Howdy.', "Oh, hey, it's y'all.", "Howdy. Where y'all headed today?", "How's the road been treatin' ya?", "Y'all are lookin' well.", "What in tarnation are you boys doin' here?", 'Worried about me?', "Ah. You got me there. The thicket's off-limits to official Hunters ‘less it's a matter of life an' death. Reckon it's too late in this case. One of our hunters headed into the woods on a rescue mission and hasn't come back.", "Sorry for the trouble, boys. Oughta be a hut a little ways ahead. Lady there might know somethin' 'bout the hunter. I'd go myself, but regulations say collectin' tags ain't reason enough to head into the thicket. I'm headin' back. Y'all be safe. Hate to lose you boys in there, too.", "Y'all made it back. Did you get it?", "What'd she say?", "Is that right? Thanks for lettin' me know. That's exactly what I needed to hear. Been beatin' myself up since I got back to HQ. Felt like I had to go find that tag—so why didn't I? I was followin' the rules, just like I should. But if I was doin' what's right, then how come it felt so wrong? Reckon I really don't got what it takes to lead the Hunters quite yet. Least now I know what I've been missin' this whole time, thanks to you boys. Y'all have done more for me than you'll ever know. May have a long way to go, but I can start by delivering this tag to the people who need it.", "I see your hunter's instincts brought y'all back here. Mine're tellin' me there's somethin' real shady 'bout these shakes. Got all my hunters foragin' the field for clues as we speak. Even enlisted the help of a fella from Galdin. Name's Dino, real upright fella. Said he found himself a suspect spot. Y'all mind goin' to check it out for me?", "Y'all oughta be proud of yourselves for takin' down that adamantoise. You boys made hunter history. Congratulations."]

Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ["According to my sources, the empire, giving strict orders not to let any vessels leave the docks of Altissia. Real shame if you were late to your own wedding—right, Prince Noctis? Name's Dino, by the way. Pleasure. The crown prince of Lucis, bounty hunting in his fancy car... Surely you didn't think it'd go unnoticed—at least not by this reporter? Lucky for you, this reporter has integrity. If you wanna remain incognito, I'll respect your wish... in exchange for a favor.", "Hey, I knew you'd come around! Lemme see your map.", 'The sound of tacit agreement! Here.', "Marked where you need to go on your map. All you gotta do is find me some rough gemstones—like this one. Do this, and your ship'll come in. Don't, and the papers'll run you outta town. Capisce?", "I'll make sure you got a boat to ride, alright?", "So what's the scoop on this little road trip anyway? Some kind of secret bachelor gig?", "Nice work, kid! Sorry for giving you such a hard time. I just had to get my hands on this, even if it meant blackmail. You understand, don't ya? Y'see, I'm a reporter by day, and an amateur jeweler by night. This elusive little beauty's gonna become a masterpiece. To make it up to you, I'll share a little scoop. That special coin you got—it commemorates the Oracle's ascension. That guy was tossing 'em out to everyone. Musta picked 'em up back in Niflheim. And speaking of freebies, here's one from me. Come back if you wanna buy more!", "As promised, I'm in the process of securing your ferry tickets right now. Told ya, I'm a man of integrity. Should be smooth sailing from here, so lemme know when you're ready to ship out.", 'You guys ready to set sail?', "Already!? The ship won't arrive 'til tomorrow! How 'bout you find a place to spend the night?", "Sheesh! Thought I'd never get through. Good to hear your voice, Highness. You recognize mine, don't ya? It's Dino!", "Got that right—the best around. Listen, I been worried about how youse guys are doin'. How's about you drop by Galdin and mingle for a bit?", 'There he is! The prince himself. Ya look good!', "Done and done. Man, I tell ya, this reporter gig alone ain't enough to pay the bills. So I've, uh, been workin' real hard on the side.", 'Yep. So, you busy?', '‘Cause I need your help! You fetch me some ore, I trade you one of my pieces. Just like last time—badabing, badaboom!', "You know where to go, don't ya? I'll be waitin'!", "What a relief all those rumors about you gettin' iced weren't true. Otherwise who would I have to fetch gems for me?", "Youse guys must be beat after all that runnin' around. Why don't ya get a massage before you go?", 'Hey, ya made it back! Youse guys hold up alright out there?', "Excellent. C'mon, you oughta be proud of yourself, Your Highness! The work you did today could save lives.", "Y'see, most folks know better than to go out at night. But some people don't have a choice—am I right?", "They may not have a choice, but my pieces can give 'em a chance. So hey, how's about you give it a try and see for yourself? I'm a man of my word, so here you go. I look forward to doin' business with you again sometime, gentlemen.", 'You really know how to sniff out a scoop, Your Highness. You, uh, just might have a future in journalism.', "Touché. So look, I need a hand. Thing is, it's too dangerous for your average joe. That's where you come in. I'll make it worth your while!", 'Whaho, touché!', 'Believe me: if I could go on my own, I would.', 'I already told you everything I know. The rest is up to you.', 'I tell ya, this raw stones are always in the darndest of places.', 'Hey, fellas! Geez, that went quicker than I expected. Bet those daemons were no match for you, huh, ince-pray?', "Well, you're alive, so... as promised! That baby right there's unlike anything you've seen before. Drop by again sometime and let me know what you think!", 'Yo! Talk about impeccable timing.', "So Your Majesty's a mind reader. Well? What am I thinking?", "Bingo! I think we got a real good thing goin' here.", "I already told you where to go. What're you waiting for? Go on!", 'I try asking the Hunters for help, and they shoot me down. Guess my stone hunts are too hard for them to handle.', 'Gotta say, having you around puts my mind at ease. Royalty like you know what these rough gems are really worth!', "This stuff's beautiful! And not a scratch on it. Oh, what about youse guys?", 'Oh, uh, what about youse guys?', "Relax. I knew you'd be fine—all thanks to my handiwork. You held up your end of the bargain, so I'll hold up mine. I'm proud to present you with one of my pieces. I think you'll find it to your liking. If you want more, stop by again!", 'You guessed it—stone search.', "Yeah, well, read my mind all you like, but I don't got a lot to share. None of my associates had much luck looking into the place, so if you can't do it, just fuhgeddaboudit.", "Look, I appreciate youse guys helpin', but don't do nothin' stupid. Capisce?", "Y'see, I'm a man with a dream. I ain't satisfied makin' some garage sale trinkets.", 'My apologies about the lack of information. All I can say for sure is that the place is dangerous.', "Holy crap. It's you!", "Get outta here. Of course I am! I just can't believe youse guys made it back so soon—and with the loot! Here. You're gonna love it. Don't trust me? See for yourself!", "Hey. Lookin' good, Your Majesty. You'd a—You'd do me a favor, right?", "You know it. But this time's different: it's real important.", "Okay, take it easy there, wise guy. Listen, this is big. If you get me this ore, I'll be able to do this jeweler gig full-time.", 'C\'mon, show me some love! If I get my hands on this stuff, I\'ll be unstoppable. I ain\'t just talkin\' Galdin here. I\'m talkin\' global Dino domination! I\'m gonna be rollin\' in so much gil, the Hunters\'ll be askin\' me to help search for stones! So what I\'m tryin\' to say is, this could be a turning point for your pal Dino—hence, "real important." Unfortunately, this soon-to-be ex-reporter ain\'t got much of a scoop. So, don\'t beat yourselves up if you come back empty-handed. But hey, here\'s hopin\' against hope you come through. Good luck out there, pal!', "I don't wanna send youse guys to your doom, but if you wanna do me one last favor, I ain't gonna say no.", "I guess I ain't opposed to livin' out my days as a reporter, but if you can help me get the goods, I'll be a changed man.", "If I gotta give up, so be it. But like they say, it ain't over 'til the fat lady sings.", 'You did it. You really did it.', "Well, I'm an artisan first and foremost, not a salesman. You know the Ring of the Lucii, right?", "That little baby put up a wall strong enough to keep out the daemons and the whole mother-lovin' empire. How cool is that?", "Yeah, yeah. See, that's the level I'm aimin' for. Not this second, of course. I got my sights set a little lower for now, but it's only a matter of time.", "Ya probably heard on the news how the nights are growin' longer and the daemon population's gettin' bigger. People need protection. And if I really give it my all, I think I can provide that for 'em. Here. You ain't gonna find anything better in all of Eos, and she's all yours. Well, I guess I got my work cut out for me!", "Well, if it isn't ince-pray Octis-nay! Dave probably told you, but I'm out here reportin' on the earthquake.", "Since we're on good terms, let me share a little scoop: word on the street is that the crag itself is the key. That, uh, Crown City chick Monica? Yeah, well uh, she's followin' up on a lead in Longwythe for me.", 'Whoa! ‘Ey, congrats on taking that thing down, huh? I mean seriously, impressive stuff. I tell you it, uh, kinda makes me want to write articles again.']

Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ["The cause of the quakes? Ah, I'm afraid I must direct you to Monica. I'm simply here to look out for Lady Iris and young Talcott. And that's all I have to say. Apologies for not being of help."]

Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ["Well met, Prince Noctis. I've heard all about you. You and your exploits. I think it's time you took the next step. Don't you?", "Well, my boy, let me explain. I look after eight seals. Seals that help protect this kingdom. Maybe you've seen them, in your to-ing and fro-ing. Strange doors, tucked away in caves and ruins. This here is the key that opens them all. Beyond each door lurks a terrible evil. One that not even our most seasoned hunters dare to take on. But you're more than that now. That's right—you have the power of kings flowing through your veins. You're the only one I'd trust this key to. No one else.", "Those seals are bound to break sooner or later. It's better to strike first, on our own terms.", 'Listen up. Death lurks behind every one of those doors. You must go prepared.', 'Good to see you back, boys. I heard what you did. You faced the threats, and defeated them all. With this, you fulfilled a promise that was made long ago by none other than your father.', 'It was some thirty years ago. His Majesty came here, stood on that very spot, and took the vow.', 'Mmm-hm. Exactly. As soon as the war was over, he said.', "When the Crown City fell to the empire, I thought it spelt the end of Lucis. I truly did. But a light that burns so brightly, doesn't go out so easily. Thank you, Prince Noctis. For everything. So long as you're alive, I know that the kingdom is safe.", 'Ah, here to report a hunt, are ya?', 'You got a story you wanna share with old Ezma?', 'Well met, boys. All this commotion had me curious, so I came down from HQ to check it out.', "I see they weren't making a mountain out of a molehill. This one might even be too much for the Hunters to surmount. Doesn't mean it isn't worth trying, though—and this old girl ain't about to let her boy Dave have all the fun.", "So you boys came face-to-face with the adamantoise. Gotta admit I'm a little jealous. You'll have to tell me all about it sometime."]

Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ["Hear me, O King of the Stone. By the Stormsender's blessing will the path to the Stone be opened. The Oracle goes hence in her King's name.", 'The eye of the Storm. When the covenant is forged, the Oracle and ring shall await their King at the Walls of Water. Stray not from the path.', 'Unto the King alone, this voice is heard.', "To follow the words is to follow the chosen path. Bridging heaven and earth it strikes, the Storm's ephemeral yet eternal light. To the Light must go the King.", 'Within the Walls of Water, the Oracle awaits... ... the coming of the king. Do not delay.', "Finite is the Oracle's strength, and great is the toll of the covenant. Without the King, it will be too much to bear.", 'Ah, the young prince is recovering well.', 'Gentiana, a Messenger. The prince has read of our kind?', 'Lady Lunafreya.', 'It is heartening to see the future King and the Oracle enjoy such familiarity. The fate of our world may depend on it.', "The revelation of the Stormsender awaits the King... Hurry hence to the eye of the Storm. Foreign hordes fear the True King's ascension. The fearful seek to seal the path of what must come.", "The Oracle's call awakens the gods... ... that their blessings find the King.", 'The covenant is forged, but the revelation awaits. Make now for the Stormsender and let judgment be passed.', 'By revelation is the power of the Six manifest. The Stone commands that the King receive it.', 'O King. Journey to Fociaugh, the eastern hollow.', 'The seal has been lifted. Deep within the heart of rock lies the runestone, the portal to power. No other can be allowed to find it.', 'Ahead lies a future uncertain, yet sure is the astral memory, wherein the King may walk.', 'At first, the father had mourned the fate of his chosen son. Yet in Tenebrae, the two found solace. It was not the Oracle who assuaged their fears. But the girl... she holds... the true power.', 'Let it now be done... as promised to the Oracle.', 'O King of Kings, restore Light unto the world.', 'Wherefore does the lady weep?', 'Yet others need not hide their grief. Is she so different from them?', "The lady's thoughts have been heard. The love she bears the king shall never fade—and, in time, her feelings shall be known unto him.", "And if the words are not spoken from her lips, then the Messengers shall see that they are heard. The gods' favor and the lady's love shall be with him evermore.", 'Thus it is promised between the Oracle and her familiar.']

Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ['You come to prove yourself worthy of my mantle?', 'And what is it you hope to glean?', 'Is that so?', 'Brute force alone does little to impress. Only he who possesses both muscle and mettle of equal caliber deserves the honor of fighting beside the Chosen King as his sworn Shield.', 'A great evil threatens the people of your world. It is but the King of Kings and his Shield who can safeguard their lives. All those unworthy or unwilling to rise to the task meet their end here, by my blade.', 'If you do not fear death, then go forth with reckless abandon and prove your worth.', 'Brandishing your brute force?', 'You only delay the inevitable, O Unworthy One. Look how you tremble!', 'With every passing second, the fear in your heart grows greater still.', 'Yes. Why else would you have come here, if not to join the other lost souls?', 'Blind reliance on strength alone reveals your weakness of will.', 'Countless disappointments met their end here, and so shall you!', 'You are strong—yet so long as fear binds your heart... ... the power you possess is wasted on you.', 'Spoken like a true Shield of the King.', 'Fear and doubt beget death alone. He who averts his gaze from his own faults cannot himself a true Shield call, but you—having made peace with your inner self—have proven you are worthy. The Chosen King should be so fortunate as to have a man like yourself serving at his side.', 'And with this glaive, I entrust my power to you.', 'Taken from the young man who impressed me with his strength of will. It was with this very blade he stole from me my arm.', 'If he still walks among the living, a man of his mettle will have doubtless transcended attachment to mere material possessions.', 'Now, hasten forth—with mind unclouded by doubt and will unmoved by fear. The Last King of Lucis is ill fit to fight without his Shield.']

Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ['Not like you had to deliver a formal address...', "We'll see the prince to Altissia if it's the last thing we see.", 'I think we can forget about hitching our way there... Thought people were friendly outside the city.', 'Just gonna have to push her all the way.', 'Oh, get up.', "C'mon, car isn't gonna move itself.", 'Can it. Ready...', 'Steady... Push!', 'Not exactly a fairy tale beginning, huh, Prince Noctis?', "Let's just hope this isn't some omen.", 'What?', 'All by myself?', "Prompto, don't even think about it.", 'Nuh-uh! We just switched back there!', 'You rather I kill you with mine?', 'Looks that way on a map of the world.', 'Well, that makes you...', 'Well, might as well make good use of the extra time.', "Old man's in for both after charging us that much.", "We're strapped for cash. Any way we could earn a little?", "Old man's got his eye on you, Noct. Show him what you got!", "You got all those arms at your disposal. Use 'em!", 'The hell do you think did this?', "You sure? Hammerhead doesn't have a scratch on it.", 'Better not be the "varmint" Cindy was talking about.', 'Haven\'t you ever heard, "the best offense is a good defense"?', "And after that, we hop a boat, and before you know it, loverboy's hitched.", "Hey, Noct! Warp-strike to catch 'em off guard!", 'He went missing?', 'We are now.', 'Hey, what about that shack over there?', "Yeah, don't think we'll be befriending any.", "And look who's in here—the man of the hour. Dave, right? Been looking for you.", "Way to show some spunk. You oughta follow Weskham's example, open up a restaurant.", 'Not nearly as much as he claims.', "What's there to spoil?", 'So yeah, no wedding just yet.', "Hey, don't hate me.", "Yeah. At least not 'til all of this is over. Can't in good conscience leave a girl to worry while I rush headlong into danger.", 'No acting here. I keep it real with the ladies.', "Well, fellas, we're homeward bound at last. Time to suit up.", 'Home, sweet home.', 'Next stop: the Citadel.', 'Yeah.', "We haven't fought together like this in ages.", 'Leave it to the MTs to stick around. There's still gonna be cleanup when all is said and done.", 'Might be able to salvage the buildings without structural damage.', "Lestallum's packed to the gills now.", "Wearin' a scowl on his face the whole time.", 'Used to frequent a joint around here, but those days are over.', 'We were too focused on the road trip.', "So even that wasn't enough?", 'What can we do to kill it?', 'The flames never stop.', 'Someone got a little rusty.', "That's our next stop.", "Guess he's expecting company.", "Think the elevator's workin'?", 'The throne room... waits outside.', 'Acting like he owns the place.', 'Remember how nervous we were in front of King Regis the day we left?', "We'll witness firsthand whether their story comes true.", 'Hmph. Hmph, guess a king forgives and forgets.', "Uh, interesting choice there, Noct. Guess, uh, Big Brother's gotta turn a blind eye every now and again.", 'The more I look at it, the better it looks.', "Now can't beat that... A shot of all four of us together.", "Spite's all that's kept him going.", "It's all you.", 'Can it. Ready... Steady...', 'Push!', 'Not exactly a fairy tale beginning, huh, Prince Noctis?', "Let's just hope this isn't some omen.", 'What?', 'All by myself?', "Prompto, don't even think about it.", 'Nuh-uh! We just switched back there!', 'You guys even pushing?', 'Nice.', 'Hey, is that all you got?', 'Out with it.', 'You spit it out.', 'Well, we got the key. Do we use it?', 'Hey, now! Finally making some headway.', "Look at the size of it! It's freakin' huge!", "That's not a beast, that's a mountain.", "I've heard of moving mountains, but taking one down? That's a twist.", 'Reminds you just how tiny we are in the big picture.', "Look at the size of it! It's freakin' huge!", 'Piece of cake, huh?', "Old guy's a character, huh?", "Cool. Let's take this stuff back to the old man.", "Cool. Let's take this stuff back to the old man.", 'Whoa, this is awesome!', "I'm stuffed.", 'My compliments to the chef.', 'This?', 'Just a scratch. The other guy got off a lot worse.', 'Yeah—who do you think it is?', 'Are you here yet?', 'Good. Thanks for agreeing to meet with me.', 'So... Are you ready to move out?', "Of course. I'll be right over.", "Just a water's fine. Thanks.", "I went up against the high commander and got my ass handed to me. I didn't stand a chance. And I never will unless I get more power.", "You think I would've called you here if I weren't?", 'Except for you. You undertook the trial, and you made it back alive.', 'Just said it was "business." I am here to undertake the Trial of Gilgamesh.', "Power—and you're gonna give it to me.", 'Ready or not!', "You saying I don't?", 'I ain\'t meeting mine any time soon. This "trial" hasn\'t even begun.', 'You are ready for this.', 'So, the Blademaster...', 'Better rest here while I can.', 'So, no mercy for newbies like me.', "So what—the weak aren't worthy of serving as Shield?", "But you weren't killed. Maybe you weren't worthy of serving as Shield, but he must've seen you as worthy of living.", 'No point in overthinking it.', 'Done and done.', 'Not good—they keep on coming!', 'And raring to go!', "What's this?", 'Thanks for the advice—and for the pick-me-up.', 'My father never undertook the Trial of Gilgamesh, did he?', "I do. I mean, it can't be because he was scared, right?", "A little, but I'm gonna do what's right for me like my father did what was right for him.", "He never pried into my business, so I won't dig into his.", 'How long has it been since you undertook the Trial? Thirty years or so?', 'This place look familiar to you?', 'Another trial chamber.', 'Leave it to me.', "Gotta say, this place ain't like anywhere else in Lucis.", "I don't think so.", 'Thanks for the vote of confidence.', 'Aww. A warm welcome, just for me.', 'Time to take a load off.', 'You said it\'s been thirty years. Were you as "immortal" then as you are now?', 'The Blademaster—what was he like?', "We'll see about that.", "Nah, I'm fine not knowing.", 'Yeah, easier said than done.', "Maybe, but it ain't for you or me to decide.", 'Well, what about you? I wanna know what was going through your head back then.', 'I mean, you were a lot younger than I am.', "That's rough... Still, you made it back alive—something no one else has ever done—and I respect that.", "Don't flatter yourself. Forget I even asked.", 'You looking to die again?', 'Whose?', 'How come?', 'So, you gonna stop me?', "I'll be fine. Maybe I'll come back with a souvenir.", "There's a chill in the air... I can feel his presence. He'd better be ready for me.", "I'm here.", "Yeah. Let's see if you can handle it.", "I ain't afraid of you.", 'So what do I do? Just roll over and die?', "Because I've got what it takes—and I'm gonna prove it!", "I've still got some tricks up my sleeve, too.", 'I kneel before no man!', 'Not exactly the "souvenir" I had in mind. But hey, at least I\'m not walking away empty-handed. I\'d better get going. In that case, don't mind if I do.", 'Thanks again.', 'Sure did.', 'Brought this back with me, too. I can't catch a break.", "C'mon, let him have some fun. It ain't easy being a wanted man.", "What's got these two so excited all of a sudden?", "It's definitely different than usual.", 'Hey, Noct!', 'What kinda crazy stunt is that?', 'And I take it you two are friends?', "So, can you tell me what this Assassin's Festival thing is all about?", 'I was asking her.', 'Go figure.', 'Is somebody shy?', "Well, I'll see you guys later. But not without him noticing.', "I'll grab his attention.", 'What do you think?', 'Use that brain of yours. Go!', 'Hey, over here!', "Not without the last keycard—and that one's with Loqi.", "Fine—but you're not going alone.", "I'm on it. After all, it wouldn't be right of me to let a pretty lady fend for herself out there.", "We should've asked Iggy for a plan!", "We shouldn't have sent him with her.", 'Word on the street is the Assassins are the ones who sent the empire packing.', "What're you doing here?", 'Him? Wouldn't want to make a fool of yourself with Cindy watching.", "Don't take it to heart.", 'Sure are.', 'And since when is there a king worthy of my protection?']

Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ["Testing! Do you read me? Just wanted to thank you for offering to clear out those daemons! That'll give me time to treat this mythril for you. There's a hunter who went in right ahead of you. I imagine there're too many for one to handle... ... but two of you should be fine! And a little heads-up: we're getting some unstable readings from the generators inside. Too much power and the whole place could blow, so be quick!", "Red alert, you two! We're detecting a major power surge. She's gonna blow! Abort the mission and get outta there!", "Great work in there! As promised, here's your mythril. And thank you for your hard work.", "You guys don't owe me a gil! Cindy offered to take me out as thanks.", 'Tell Cindy to give me a call!', "Hey, if it isn't my favorite hunter.", "Who else? The name's Holly, by the way—forgot to tell you earlier. Thanks for taking care of those daemons! I tell ya, that was a real shock, having them show up at the plant. I was so shocked, as a matter of fact, I went and did my back in.", "Yep. It's giving me all kinds of grief. I can barely shuffle ten feet. But wouldn't you know it, the girl in charge of the valves is off today. And her job is to go through town and check they're all shut down.", "What, you? I don't know... Sure. Why not? If it's no trouble, that is.", 'The valves might be hard to find. I wish I could help.', "I was wringing my hands, wondering what to do about the valves. When you get to my age, you'll understand.", 'You checked them all? Every one?', 'Thank you! While you checked valves, I had my back checked out. But the doctor—he just said it was a bad case of the nerves.', "I heard the word daemon, I stiffen up like a corpse. Anyway, here's a little something. Buy yourselves a meal.", "Ah, there's my favorite hunter. Hey, can you do a girl a favor?", "We're in charge of operating the ropeway, and it's acting up. We need to figure out the problem. First thing is fact gathering. Can you go and take a look at the pylons that are outside? There's no way I can send any of the regular staff out there. It's just too much for them to handle. I'd go myself, except the plant workers are having a massive dispute. I'm the only one who can sort it all out.", 'Be careful of the daemons. If it starts to get dark, hurry up and find a safe place to spend the night.', "The fight among the workers is serious. To be honest, I don't know which of us has the more dangerous job!", "It takes a real tough sort to go outside. No one on my roster's cut out for it.", 'Welcome back. So, you checked things out?', "Seriously? Thanks. I guess that means I don't have to worry about it anymore.", "Thought so. Thanks for the help. I can take care of the problem now that I know where it is. We can't afford to lose our power. Without it, we couldn't keep the lights on and the town safe at night. Thanks again. This is for you.", "Hey, hunter. How're things with you?", 'That obvious? Company asked me to check on all the lights. Our regular hunters are booked on other jobs. So the company picked me. Promised extra danger pay.', "Thing is, it's too far to get there and back in a day. And I can't stand daemons. But I said yes, dammit, and now it's my responsibility.", "You can? ... I don't want anyone thinking I'm shirking my duties. But who am I kidding? It's beyond me. So, yeah, would you help me out?", "When I get asked to do something, I just can't say no. Real bad habit.", "Even if a task is way over my head, I can't turn my back on it. Inspections are important, you know?", 'The lights are vital, and they need to be checked. But please, watch out for the daemons.', "He's back! How'd it go?", "I appreciate your help, but more than that I feel bad. I won't foist work on you again.", "Fact is, I've been taking on too much. I only end up passing it on to other people. Kind people like you. That's not the way to do a job. It took a while, but I realize that now. I had a dear friend. She was killed... by daemons. That's why I joined this company. So I could bring more light into the world and prevent tragedy.", "Yeah... I can't change the past, but I can change my ways. From now on, I won't hesitate to say no. It's only the responsible thing to do, if I want to protect people like I mean to. You've done so much for me. I can't thank you enough. But here—please take this as a small token of my appreciation.", "If it isn't my favorite hunters! You looking into what's causing all these earthquakes?", "Everyone at the power plant's up in arms. They're all wondering if the Meteor has got anything to do with 'em. The company's offering a bonus to anyone who can solve the mystery, so I figured I'd take up the cause and earn some extra gil.", 'Hey! So you know, I submitted my official report to the company, and I made sure to say what a great job you did!', "Say, I didn't realize you knew my favorite hunters.", "Simmer down, now. I'd be happy to tell you all about it. We're also lending out costumes to the festivalgoers. Whether you wear them is up to you, but they're perfect for the occasion!", 'You boys sure wear those costumes well!', "They're designed to help you get in the spirit. Now go out there and have fun!", 'You wanna learn more about the festival?', 'You really pull that look off! They both look great on you.', 'Need something?', "If you think I'd let you leave that hunk of junk in my plant, you'd better think again. You can't come in here and manhandle our power supply! It takes a woman's touch.", 'As if I would agree.', "Well, if you insist, have your men return my keycards. Can't monitor the inner workings of the plant from the outside.", "I can't thank you enough, Mister Hunter.", 'Hope you enjoy the festival!']

Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ['So, the prince eludes death. And what of the elusive ring?', 'Find and kill her. The ring is the final piece.', 'So glorious... my Crystal...', "The ring... It's mine...", "The empire shall span... all the lands... By the Crystal's Light... we shall flourish... I shall arise... as ruler... of the world!", "What of the Hydraean's power? What of my precious ring?", 'But the Crystal is mine... I am the one True King!', 'You are the puppet... and you must die.', 'Thieves cannot escape the hand of justice. The Crystal is mine... Never shall I lose my grip! The Crystal, the Light, the power... All of it... Mine!']
