Let's find the next one.", 'On your guard.', 'The best among a field without hunters.', "She's a woman who takes a lot of pride in her work.", "Can't say I've heard anything to that effect.", "She claimed to be an apothecary, yet I didn't spy any curatives lying around her hut.", '"Do not follow. Trust yourself." Sound advice.', 'Not as sound as I thought, perhaps.', "I'd heard tall tales of this fish, but... does it truly exist?", 'How shall we cook it?', 'You were wise not to give him your real name.', 'Thankfully, the prince is alive and well.', "I believe so. Let's hurry back with it.", 'Could it be the confection you received from... Lady Lunafreya?', "We've quite a ways to go until we reach Altissia, so keep gushing to your heart's content.", 'The anticipation alone is a foreign sensation.', "And there's still more to come.", 'A serpent said to embody the roar and rage of the sea.', 'Indeed. Her well-being is top priority.', 'The empire did invade Lucis for the ring. I have no faith their ruthless ambitions will stop short of harming the Oracle.', 'It seems likely His Majesty entrusted it to her safekeeping back at the Crown City.', 'You know, I was thinking back to our encounter with Ravus.', 'Do you recall an apparatus in place of his arm?', 'Seems he lost his old one in the invasion. But in its place, he seems to have acquired new power.', "There's a disturbing rumor about. Lord Ravus has taken to brandishing His Majesty's sword.", 'I cannot say for sure, but I have my doubts. Ravus wears the sword, yet does not wield it.', "Consider it a guarantee. They felled a god to prevent Noct from receiving his blessing, and they'll do so again.", 'The chancellor has an agenda all his own.', 'Certainly hope not.', 'As Gladio said, his actions are motivated not by altruism, but by self-interest. And when he does come to our aid, I see only condescension in his eyes.', "Sometimes, but it's always preferable to the alternative.", 'I was given to understand you stayed in touch.', 'Yes, we believe so.', "You'll see for yourself: foreign lands seldom lend themselves to trite explanations.", 'Lodgings are our first order of business.', "And you're welcome to sleep in the wild.", "Won't be much longer now, Noct.", 'Prepared in advance?', "We are scholars of the culinary arts, and we've come to study the renowned cuisine of your fair nation.", 'Another one you owe me.', "Perhaps we'll even make it in time for tea.", 'An estranged friend of the king.', 'Take care not to get lost.', "I've got another pair, just in case.", "Doubtless. The designer's name is the same.", "True enough. Let's keep an eye out for it.", 'Seems everyone is making for the shop.', "Good to know the prince isn't completely forgotten.", 'You truly get the sense.', "Seems we're on the right track.", "And that's the dress. My word.", 'A fine idea.', 'Do you see that, Noct?', '"Peace be unto the province"...', "After the journey with His Majesty, he settled here and opened shop. He's an odd specimen.", "The Archaean's awakening resulted in the destruction of the Disc, yet the government proceeds with the rite. There's more to this than we understand.", "Based on the government's actions, it would seem Accordo is supportive of the Oracle.", 'Therein lies the riddle: is Lady Lunafreya truly safe?', "We'll bear that in mind.", 'Where is Lady Lunafreya?', 'First secretary of the Accordo Protectorate.', "There's no telling how events will unfold. Let us prepare before making our way.", "What's that?", 'Prompto. Camera.', 'During the rite, we must see to it the empire does not harass Leviathan.', 'Indeed. The best we can realistically do is to help the Hydraean help herself.', 'Just like Titan, the empire will seek to immobilize Leviathan.', 'If we can dislodge them from the goddess, she will have a fighting chance.', 'Stay flexible, stay alert.', 'Of course.', "Noct, the empire's here.", 'Drop ships are closing in on the port. Look for a vantage point to approach them.', 'Noct. The Hydraean has awoken.', 'The empire has the Hydraean surrounded. Hurry, Noct!', 'Noct! Prompto is headed your way.', "We'll wait below—there's only room for two.", 'Back with us?', "I'll tell the others... though it may take a bit.", 'A small sacrifice in the greater battle.', 'She has passed.', 'Umbra left that for you.', 'Not before visiting the royal tomb in Cartanica.', "The wounds have mended. Eyesight's a matter of time.", 'Enough, Gladio!', "We'll be on foot in Cartanica. The Regalia may be aboard, but she won't be of much use without paved roads.", "I'm afraid not.", "We'll be on foot in Cartanica.", 'Noct?', 'Ready to set out?', "I'll manage somehow.", "Don't worry about me.", "We're a foreign species in this environment. Mind we don't end up prey.", 'As best I can.', 'Ah, thank you.', "Prompto... Where's the enemy?", 'Was I in the way?', 'I only wish I could do more.', "It's proving a challenge.", "Prompto, perhaps it's time for some light.", 'The hour is late. That much I can tell.', "I'm fine. Don't mind me.", 'Right.', 'If we get its motor running, perhaps we can move it out of the way.', 'Is it operational?', 'And the generators?', 'How does it look?', 'Did it work?', 'Grand.', "The tomb's further in?", 'What? What is it?', 'No. There must be a way!', 'Noct, I have an idea.', 'If I may...', 'Ah, as I suspected!', "Now, we've a fighting chance.", 'Is it dead?', 'Happy to help.', 'A moment?', "It bloody well isn't. And I won't suffer this pointless bickering in silence any longer. Let's be frank. My vision hasn't improved, and probably won't. Yet in spite of this... I would remain with you all. Til the very end.", "I know full well! I won't ask you to slow down. If I can't keep up, I will bow out.", "Noct, you are king. One cannot lead by standing still. A king pushes onward always, accepting the consequences and never looking back. Gladio, Noct will take his rightful place, but only once he's ready.", 'Crystal.', 'Feels good to ride the rails.', "Eager to drive once we're in Gralea?", "We're fortunate to have the Regalia at all. We owe the first secretary our thanks.", "Those transceivers are top-notch. I recall when the Hydraean raged— In the midst of the empire's retreat, one conspicuous craft remained behind: the chancellor's. The last thing I remember seeing was his ship, heading for the altar. I fell unconscious... and was powerless to stop him.", 'Is someone else there?', 'On a brief reconnaissance. Something caught my ear.', 'Splendid.', 'Rumors of longer nights.', 'There was talk of it back in Lucis, but recent days have shown an unseasonably sharp change. Should this trend continue, before long...', 'And longer nights mean more daemons.', 'I happened to overhear a fellow passenger discussing this very same phenomenon.', "No, we don't. Back in a moment.", "What's wrong?", "Stay calm, Noct. I'm as concerned for Prompto as you are, but stopping the train would endanger everyone onboard. We'd be sitting ducks for the daemons.", "First, we drop the passengers off at Tenebrae. We'll be arriving shortly.", 'Can you make your way here? Gladio is with me.', 'Yes.', 'Oh, uh... Just a flesh wound.', "I'm... afraid not.", 'You mentioned being part of the relief effort. We have a favor to ask.', "In light of what you've told us, we can't allow the other passengers to continue on.", 'Elaborate.', 'They emanate from the empire?', "If you intend to linger here a while, might I suggest you take a moment to speak with the people of the manor? I'm sure they'd relish the chance to share their tales of Lady Lunafreya.", 'Is the manor badly damaged?', "And the chancellor's the one who put them through it.", "Pity we never got the chance to talk things out. Hopefully His Majesty's glaive awaits us in the capital.", 'We will.', "We must be approaching the Glacian's cadaver.", 'Let us hope we pass through the gorge without incident.', "We've come quite a long way.", "Still dark? Seems there's scarcely anything left of day.", "Let's hope he's safe.", 'Indeed.', 'The Glacian did this.', "Yes, I'm fine. Let's go.", "Yes, I'm fine. Let's go.", 'We should be drawing close to Gralea.', "Once we arrive, we'll make for the Keep.", 'Zegnautus. An imperial megafortress said to be impregnable.', "The proof is in the purging, but it does stand to reason. We've observed that as the nights have grown longer, the daemon hordes have grown stronger. If they are in fact averse to the Crystal's Light, it could save not only Lucis, but the world.", 'What is it?', 'Run!', 'Only a matter of time before we run out of room to run!', 'We trade the train for the Regalia!', 'Noct! The freight car!', 'Where are we now!?', 'What was that!?', "It'll take a bit more than that to stop His Majesty's trusty steed.", 'The Regalia can take the punishment. Just focus on your driving.', 'And with no assurances the Crystal can beat back the daemon hordes.', "Let's be quick.", 'Noct? Is that you?', 'Where are you?', 'Gladio! There ought to be a kill switch nearby—find it!', "I believe it's the reason we were brought here.", 'After we were separated, we received "help"—from the usual suspect.', 'All but one of us.', 'Are you hurt? Do you need help?', 'Noct, do you hear that?', "I've heard this sound before—on the train, just before your weapons failed you. It's nearby, and it may hold the key to restoring your power.", "It's here.", "It's coming from within. Is there no way through?", "I don't see you turning against us. Not now, or ever.", "Unless you'd rather not be.", "With the device down and out, Noct's power should be up and running.", "‘Fraid not, but that doesn't mean I can't fight.", "The ring represents a great burden, but you don't bear it alone.", 'At the very least, I must try.', 'Hopefully Biggs and Wedge both made it to safety.', "She's broken down, alas.", 'Now then, the Crystal.', 'Truly be... the emperor?', 'What kind of fiend makes daemons of men?', 'Noct, you must go alone.', "If you can obtain the Crystal's power, we may yet turn the tide. Elsewise, we are all like to perish here.", 'Is there a way forward?', 'But now Noct is facing them alone. There must be some way we can help him.', "I'm loath to trust him.", 'I ought to have been more cautious. If anything were to happen to Noct, I...', "You're right. What's done is done.", "I have a feeling the chancellor isn't so generous.", "He may have feigned friendship, but he's proven a foe before. We'd best be careful.", "The latter, I presume. Whatever it is must be a matter of considerable scale to warrant such a warning. Keep your ears open. These broadcasts may help us understand what's going on outside.", "It's dead silent.", 'Proceed with caution.', 'What is it?', 'Where are we now?', 'I doubt even the daemons could simply escape from such a secure facility. It\'s more likely their "master" set them free.', 'Which may help us monitor the rest of the keep. Does anything look operable?', 'All of it?', "Then we'd best have a look. Whatever's on that tape may help us locate Noct and Prompto.", 'Was that Noct?', "It sounded like Ravus tried to return His Majesty's sword.", 'And, at this point, no one left to protect them, either.', 'What is it?', "Then we're close. Do you see any sort of control panel?", "If it's anything like the Citadel, there should be a barrier barring access.", 'Right.', "I can't hear it anymore. Is it dead?", 'Nor one so fixated on the Crystal.', 'And we need to find it before it finds Noct and Prompto.', "If they did, I suspect they're no longer human enough to sympathize.", 'Assuming all of what we heard is true.', "Wait. Can't you hear that?", "Noct's voice. I heard it clear as day. This way—follow me!", 'Well, well. You kept us waiting.', "Let's head inside.", 'More or less. I can manage with far less help than I required before.', "Perhaps I've developed a culinary sixth sense.", "I'll give the matter some thought—assuming such demand still exists in a post-apocalyptic world.", "Prompto's even capable of hunting alone these days. He really has come a long way.", "Not as individuals, perhaps, but we no longer need to ask one another for help in times of need. We've reached the point where that sort of synergy is second nature.", "So we can't expect a formal introduction for some while, then.", 'Or acting.', 'Wear them with pride.', "What we've been waiting for...", 'With pleasure.', "Certainly! It's a spot worth taking note of.", 'We certainly lived at our own pace.', 'I sense trouble.', 'No time for compliments.', "That's the way!", 'Of course.', 'Sullied garments are ill-fitting for a king.', 'Indeed.', "But we'd rather not remember.", 'Yes... Our king.', 'Always came in handy.', 'Perfect synergy!', "I don't need sight to sense what's around me.", "What kingly confidence you've acquired.", "Even Aranea's been taught a thing or two.", 'Once this is all over...', 'Fair enough.', 'Many would return, given the chance.', 'And the prince worked part-time nearby.', "And if we'd been at the signing, we'd not be here now.", 'We left here that day, knowing nothing of what lie ahead.', 'To a degree, yes.', 'I should.', "It's taken a turn for the worse.", 'Going out in a blaze.', 'On we go.', 'At long last, the Citadel.', 'He is really taking us by the hand.', "It's time to take it all back.", 'That was the last time we were in here.', 'Do the paintings of the prophecy still adorn the walls?', 'It no doubt reminded him of the fate his son would come to bear.', 'I recall a young prince leaving his mark on a painting. Is it still there?', 'Ironically, since he was to be the King of Light.', 'Well, shall we, Noct?', 'Always something new around every corner.', 'Only befitting the Regalia be included in the shot.', "Ah, yes... It wouldn't have been a road trip without her.", 'How about a shot of us as we set off from Caem?', 'We conquered insurmountable odds on many an occasion.', "Really brings back memories, doesn't it?", 'The camera can only hold so many pictures.', "Really brings back memories, doesn't it?", 'This is it. Listen to your heart, Noct.', 'You... chose a picture with nobody in it. Must have some significance to you.', 'Indeed. It was always reassuring to know that the marshal was in our corner.', 'Was I not present in the majority of photographs?', 'You can really see the change.', 'Suppose you found your regality, Noct.', 'The pictures of those days are still fresh in my mind.', "Hmm. Easy to get lost in all the memories we've shared.", 'Through it all, we had each other.', 'Ardyn sits the throne?', 'So this is farewell.', 'Godspeed... and take care.', 'Majesty.', 'We let ourselves get carried away.', 'Save some breath for pushing.', "We'll be there in no time.", 'Hmm... An eternity.', "It's good to hear.", 'It seems highly likely.', 'At last, we have broken the seal.', 'Perhaps this is one hunt we should reconsider.', 'Noct! Do you seriously mean to do this?', "Tiny and short-lived, besides. Some mountains aren't meant to be climbed, though with time, we might conquer it.", "After an infinite regression, we arrived at an answer: the turtle's all the way down.", 'He has an uncommon zeal for his craft.', "That's it. Let's deliver it to Randolph.", 'This is the material that Randolph seeks.', "Let's not speculate. Let's ask an expert.", 'Taking the high road.', 'My pleasure. Did you enjoy your time with the marshal?', 'Speaking of which, who was this "other guy"?', 'Not unlike the licking the marshal received back when he was a lad.', "If the Blademaster sequestered himself during the Founder King's reign, then he's haunted those halls for some two millenia.", 'And I, as well.', "We'll be arriving shortly, gentlemen.", "Need I remind you there's an imperial bounty on your head? Keep it in check.", "The two of them happen to be rather fond of theAssassin's Creed series.", 'And all of these cars.', 'Noct!', "The Leap of Faith—one of the Assassins' most astounding acrobatic feats.", 'They would certainly serve as an ideal disguise given the current state of the town.', 'Is the real thing this revealing?', "No, it's... simply a new sensation.", 'Not by choice; the outfits are revealing by design.', "We'll reconvene tonight at the Leville.", "I'd fancy a walk up there.", 'To walk or not to walk...', 'It sounds like they employed some sort of jamming device, one that prevents you unleashing your power to its full potential.', "Our only option is to infiltrate the power plant and interrupt the empire's interference.", "Then it's settled. Our first order of business should be to gather a bit more intel. Noct, you and Prompto should scout out Loqi's subordinates from the tower in front of the main thoroughfare.", 'Indeed.', 'Our target should be posted somewhere in the very back of the marketplace. The soldiers patrolling the area, however, will make procuring the keycard somewhat difficult.', "Of sorts. I'll watch from the rooftop and inform you of their movements.", 'Just be careful not to get caught along the way.', 'On your right, Noct!', 'Now!', 'To the left!', 'Up ahead!', 'Look out!', 'Get back!', 'Hide!', 'So far, so good.', 'A bit further.', 'Then we need to find him. Back to reconnaissance it is.', 'And which of us will be providing backup?', "As you wish. I'll take pains to keep her safe.", 'Patience! We only need to hold out a bit longer!', 'Have a little faith.', 'That "word" should save us a world of hassle.', 'As it were... I already did.', "Didn't want to distract with my sideshow-of-sorts. My apologies.", 'It would appear the key is finding your center of balance.', 'MTs.', 'Would look a tad out of place in the crown city.', '"Nutrition," gentlemen. His Highness could certainly do with some green in his diet.', 'I could do with a bath.', 'You take pride in your poor hygiene?', 'Not over the crown city, to be sure.', 'You look a bit out of sorts, Noct.', 'Any plan of attack?', "I'll circle around then.", 'Let me give the orders this time.', '... Attack.', 'Let nothing stand in your way.', 'Always.', 'Hmph. I feel the same about you lot.', "A kitchen knife... Wonder if it's a culinary battle he wants.", 'MTs!', "Gladio's hard as a rock.", "Seems Prompto's turned into a frog.", 'We can make room by leaving you behind.', "Let him have his fun, while he's still alive.", "I wouldn't count on that myself.", 'Is Prompto alright?', "Impressive, Noct. You've grown stronger.", 'The one that excludes vegetables?', "It's an eat-or-be-eaten world.", "Then let's dig in, shall we?", "And they're legging it towards us.", 'You die.', "You're not alone, but out in the wild it's kill-or-be-killed.", "We've no one to protect the king with his shield out of commission.", 'Feeling alright?', 'Yours, namely?', 'Thank you.']

Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ['Um, Noct?', "It's really you! So good to hear your voice! Everything's fine over here. We managed to make it to Lestallum. We just settled into our new digs. So, yeah. Let me know when you're coming so we can meet up.", 'You better!', 'Gladdy!', 'Hey!', 'Gladdy!', 'Look at you guys, holding your own out there.', 'All things considered. You guys are staying here, right?', 'Sure.', 'Not pretty. The Citadel took a beating. But a lot of outlying neighborhoods made it through in one piece.', "You know if there's anything else, you can ask me.", "So... about Lady Lunafreya. I keep hearing she was in town. Apparently she left right away, but at least it means she's okay.", "Yeah, well, get a good night's rest.", 'Morning, sleepyhead!', "Oh, they're out walking with Talcott. They went to see the sights. We should, too!", "Great! I'll show you around!", 'More!?', "Yes, that's exactly right. C'mon, I'll show you around!", "For our first stop, we'll check out the marketplace. Follow me, right this way.", "It's even more beautiful out here at night.", "This is the Partellum Market. You can get almost anything here. Isn't it great? I'd buy out the whole place if I could.", 'Could you at least pretend to be excited?', 'You know me so well.', "Wow! Look at all this neat stuff! I'm gonna take a look, gimme just a sec.", "Done! Next, we're gonna see the power plant.", "That's the power plant, the driving force behind Lestallum's prosperity. But get this: only women work there. As a matter of fact, women are the ones who do all the work in this town.", "I think so, too! It's so different from home. I was surprised at first. But I like it!", "I think it's kinda cool, actually. Depends on how you look at it, I guess.", "Alright! Next, we're going to the outlook!", "I'm a city girl, but I dig the rustic charm.", 'You would totally love the drinks in this place.', 'Imagine taking one for a spin?', "Pegglar Outlook. Amazing view, right? Look! There's the Meteor!", "Y'know, Noct, this almost feels like a date.", 'Would it kill you to play along for once?', 'We better keep it quiet then. And besides, you already have Lady Lunafreya.', "The others are probably back at the hotel by now. Let's join them.", "Let's see if the others are back. Haven't had fun like this since we were kids. Thanks, Noct.", "You did? I'm so happy to hear that.", 'What do you mean "babysitting"? Talk about ungrateful!', 'You did always notice the little things. Been like that since you were little.', "Anyway, the thing I bought today... It's for you. But! It's a surprise, so you're gonna have to wait.", 'This sounds dangerous. Will the four of you be alright?', 'Be on the lookout for daemons. They like dark places, after all.', "If there's trouble, use Gladdy as a meat shield.", "What's the matter? You alright?", "Are you sure you're okay?", 'Oh, Gladdy.', 'I let you down. I never made it to Caem. The empire came while you were gone.', 'None of us said a word about Noct. They just showed up and then... poor Jared.', 'There was nothing we could do!', "I'm taking Talcott, and we're going to Caem. We... We can't just stay here and do nothing.", 'Filled ‘er up for ya!', 'Ready to roll?', "Let's get this show on the road!", "Morning! Who's ready to kick some ass?", 'Looking at the Regalia really reminds me of home.', "And it's a lot roomier, too! I can't imagine trying to cram five people, including Gladdy, into one of those things. Have you ever ridden in one?", 'There was barely enough room for our luggage! Thank goodness you guys could give me a lift.', "Whoa, check it out! See that? That's the Rock of Ravatogh. I'm, like, ninety percent sure.", 'All thanks to Jared.', 'Noct...', 'Alright.', 'Oh, back so soon? Need a breather?', "You're heading back out? Okay, good luck!", "Be safe. I'll be here waiting!", 'We made it.', "Oh! While you guys were gone, I saw a chocobo run past—and it had a person on its back! Have you guys ever ridden one? I bet it'd be super fun!", "So, Noct. What're you gonna do when we get to Caem?", "Right. Can't keep Lady Luna waiting.", "Nothing! I'm having the time of my life out here on the road with you guys.", "It's too bad things can't stay this way forever, y'know? But hey—enjoy it while it lasts, right?", 'Are you guys excited to visit Altissia or what?', "I'm so jealous!", "Oh, yeah. You're right.", "What? No, I'm fine. I-I'm not jealous. I just... had a lot of fun hanging out with you guys. But that'll all be in the past once we hit Caem.", 'How come?', "Smells like there's... salt in the air.", "Wow, it's beautiful!", 'Wow! Look at that bridge up ahead!', "Guess I'll see it when we cross.", 'Wanna get a closer look?', "So, you're the one doing all the cooking?", "Gladdy, don't you help? Noct?", "That's some arrangement you guys have there.", 'Sure is! Thanks for the lift, Ignis.', 'Thanks for the ride. It was fun!', "We've decided to start living here—pretty recently, too, which is why it's so empty.", "About that lake: preeetty sure he was talking about the Vesperpool. I asked Monica to look into it, and she told me the road leading there's under imperial lockdown. You'll want to be prepared for anything. So, how's that coming along?", "Uh, okay? I'll be inside, then.", "Noct? Gladdy!? I can't believe it!", 'So, Gladdy, did you apologize to Noct for storming off like that?', "The power plant? Oh, so you got your hands on some mythril! In that case, I'll go deliver it to Cid. You'll probably want to freshen up first anyway. Come and meet me in Caem when you're ready!", 'So, remember how I picked something up at the market the other day?', 'Well, this is for you.', 'You put your life on the line everyday, so I wanted you to have a little insurance—a lucky charm. It\'s called a "moogle." This one\'s gonna look for all you guys!', "Keep him by your side, and he'll take care of you. And if he gets roughed up, I'll take care of him—I'll be in Caem! Later!", 'Good news, Noct! Our garden is up and running! So Noct, you gonna put your green thumb to the test?', 'Uh, grow vegetables? You can eat them, or sell them if you want.', 'It all starts with a seed. Here—try these!', "Oh, hey Noct. What's up?", 'Something from Noct? For me?', "It's beautiful! I love it, Noct. You're so sweet!", "I guess it's goodbye for now.", "The Regalia's already waiting below deck.", "Hopefully she'll serve you as well across the ocean as she did here.", "Just don't break her or Cid'll have your head.", "We heard rumblings of an earthquake around here and came to check it out. It's a little too close to the capital for comfort.", 'Normally, Jared\'s notebook has the answer, but it came up blank this time—except for a weird legend about Longwythe. Something about the mountain "awakening" every few centuries and making the earth shake by its rousing. That\'s the best I\'ve got.', "Hey, I heard about Longwythe. Seriously, that's amazing. You guys are gonna go down in history!", 'You guys kick ass.', 'Yeah! You look cool doing it too.', 'Never underestimate an Amicitia.', 'Speak for yourself.']

Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ['Please excuse my grandson. He has yet to learn his manners.', "Your Highness is very kind, but we shan't impose. A very good night to you, Your Highness.", 'It seems your patience was rewarded. Enjoy your walk, and please take care.', 'It may be a good idea to take in the sights while housekeeping cleans your room.', 'Oh, come now, show some respect.', 'Oh, come now, show some respect.', 'I shall pray for your safety and success.', 'Talcott is ever outgoing, and he readily mingles with the locals.', 'Do take care out there.', 'Well, well!', "Splendid. You've done well, my boy.", 'Hmm, perhaps you ought to rest a while.']

Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ['Welcome, dearies. It is I, Kimya, you seek?', 'Belonged to a fallen hunter, it did, yes? Deep inside the woods, it lies. Sent here by their leader, you were?', 'Because a strong enmity toward me, they bear. Cast me out into the forest, they did. "A witch," they called me.', 'Brew potions, I do, so a witch I must be.', 'Believe them, you do? Then explain, I shall. But first, go search, you must. Here, I wait.', 'Brew potions, I do. But very special, they are. Understand them, some do not, so "witch," they call me.', "Repel the daemons, they do. At havens, they are used. The Oracle's blessing, my potions strengthen. Long ago, healing potions, the Hunters wanted. Brewed them, I did, but very angry, their leader grew. Dangerous, my potions are, my sister said. Make them, if I must, but alone I shall be. Receive help, I shall not.", 'Terribly cruel, it was. But fault her, I cannot. Follow her heart, she did. Very important, that is. Learn to decide for himself, her son must. If he does, lead the Hunters, someday he will.', 'O-ho-ho! Come to investigate these earthquakes, have you?', 'Very unsettling, they are. A great disturbance in the earth, I sense—something outside the purview of the Stars. Whence does all this energy flow? The answer, you and I must together seek.', 'Calmed the earth, have you? Into eternal slumber has the adamantoise fallen. Learn its secrets of long life, I must. Ohoho!']

Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ['What fool mortal dares break the slumber of the Tide!? Lunafreya: It is I, Lunafreya, blood of the Oracle! Goddess of the Seas, I beseech you: enter into this covenant that the King might reclaim the Stone!', 'This wretched pile of bone and flesh, ignorant of that which governs All, comes to requisition the might of a goddess? Lunafreya: I do.', 'What does a lowly, ephemeral speck know of All Creation!?', 'Blasphemous ingrates, all men, quick to forget the ages their goddess stood watch! Lunafreya: It is in receiving mercy than men offer praise, and in shedding grace that the gods solicit worship.', 'Yet this profane speck speaks her "King" heresies before a goddess! Insufferable sacrilege!', 'If not, then the Feeding shall begin, and it shall not end until every last speck is devoured! So let the covenant be forged. Heaven and Earth, High and Deep, Birth and Return...']

Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ["Stay right where you are. Well, well, if it isn't Cor the Immortal. So you survived the Citadel. But you won't survive what I have in store for you. It's past time your legend came to an end.", "Didn't expect to meet again so soon, Highness.", 'You must be getting tired by now. Here, let me put you to sleep.', 'Impossible!', 'Which is why we require your assistance.', 'Your position does not afford you the right to protest.', 'You will be permitted access as necessary. Follow my orders, and all will be well. We provide you with peace and yet still you rebel. Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ["It's the same kind we sewed our crowns from.", 'So... I have a favor to ask. Take the notebook with you when you go.', "That's not all. I want you to put something in the book and send it back.", "Though I am still young, my blood is true. As my mother before me, I'll work to bring peace to one and all.", 'It would be selfish of me to complain of my burden, when so many suffer in wait. I hope they trust I will not rest until they all know solace.', 'If you know of any who are bedridden, or unable to come to me... Pray, send word, and I... shall go to them. I follow my calling. I will not halt my steps for anything else.', 'When war has ended, so too will suffering subside. The treaty is a momentous step towards a brighter future. Let there be no doubt: we walk the path of true peace.', 'Please, set your heart at rest. I shall do what I can to ease your suffering.', "Blessed Stars of life and light, deliver us from darkness' blight.", 'That is all I can do for now, but trust that relief will come in a matter of days.', 'You must be exhausted.', 'Let us begin at once.', 'The Crystals was gifted to mankind that we might know lasting prosperity.', 'The kings of Lucis do not simply use the Crystal; they also protect it.', 'Yes.', 'To crown the King of Light is the calling of the Crystal. And keeping the Crystal safe until that day falls to the line of Lucis.', 'Yes. Only the True King, anointed by the Crystal, can purge our star of its scourge.', "As Oracle, I will see to it. To aid the King is the Oracle's calling.", "I know you won't.", 'Understood... I shall reclaim it at the altar.', 'Right.', 'I am in your debt.', 'So be it.', 'Dear friends, I stand before you today with little hope the words I speak shall reach beyond these walls.', 'For slowly, but surely, the Light fades from our world. And as it does, the shadows shall loom ever longer until all succumbs to the darkness. Darkness that evokes terror, hatred, and sorrow in the hearts of men. The ashes of Lucis... A dream of peace twisted into a nightmare of death and destruction, claiming innumberable lives and leaving myriad souls to suffer.', 'Yet I beg you, do not surrender to despair. Have faith, for our gods watch over us. By their blessings, by the Stars that light the heavens above, our world will be delivered from the perils of the dark. I stand before you here, in Altissia, to call upon Leviathan, Goddess of the Seas, spirit of the deep. By the sacred rite, I will commune with the Hydraean. But first, I offer you my solemn vow. On my honor as Oracle, I will not rest until the darkness is banished from our world and the Light is restored.', 'Bless you all.', 'I know what you must know—that the King of Kings is to drive the darkness from our star.', 'Leviathan!', 'I vow the King will prove himself worthy!', 'I will pass the ring... to the rightful King...', 'When the prophecy is fulfilled, all in thrall to darkness shall know peace.', 'Blessed Stars of light and life...', 'Noctis.', 'So, you found your way here.', 'A chance to see you once more... Who would have thought?', 'Because my prayers have been answered. My calling fulfilled.', 'You are the One, Noctis. The Stars shine for you now. That which is yours by right shall be restored to you.', "Do you remember the flowers of Tenebrae? It seems so long ago. You'll find they await you still, blooming from hill to vale.", 'Would that I could join you... but this moment will have to be enough.', 'When the world falls down around you, and hope is lost, when you find yourself alone, amid a lightless place, look to the distance. Know that I am there, and that I watch over you always.', 'Farewell, dear Noctis.', 'I beg of you... please... see the ring to Noctis on my behalf.', 'Already... my flesh has begun to fail me.', 'But... I lack the strength to go on...', 'I have little to offer a king, other than the voice afforded the Oracle. Nevertheless...', "And—I'm afraid he might find this foolish... But... to be together with Noctis again, even if only for a short while... It... would mean the world to me.", 'I do not seek to guide him, merely to stand beside him.', 'Noctis is chosen. It is ordained. You of all people should know.', "That may be! But... it's my choice. If only...", 'If only I could... hear his voice once more... If we could laugh together as we did as children...', 'Noctis is chosen. It is ordained. You of all people should know.', "That may be! But... it's my choice. If only...", 'If only I could... hear his voice once more... If we could laugh together as we did as children...', 'If we could... live out our days together as we once dreamed...', 'Forgive me. I vowed to only cry where prying eyes cannot see the tears in mine.', 'No... She is no different at all. She wants exactly what they do: to be with the one she loves. But want though she may, it is not to be.', 'Gentiana...', 'I am undeserving of your kindness... Thank you.', 'Farewell, dear Noctis.', "I know you won't.", 'All I ask is that you continue to support Noctis, and that you remain ever at his side.']

Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ['My word... Is that you, Prince Noctis?', "Oh, blessed be the Stars. Just look at what a fine young man you've grown into. I am Maria, a retainer in service to House Fleuret. I doubt you'll remember me after these long years.", "Don't worry. Who I am is of little import—in light of what I wish to discuss. Lady Lunafreya risked everything to spirit the Ring of the Lucii away from the Citadel. Did she deliver it to you?", 'Stars above! My fears have been assuaged. Lord Ravus, too, will be overjoyed to hear this news.', 'I understand you will go hence to the imperial capital.', "Lord Ravus has King Regis's glaive in his safekeeping, and it was his wish to return it to you, my Prince. Though I imagine it will not be easy for you to find each other.", 'I pray it shall be so.', "I learned from Lord Ravus that poor Pryna also passed that tragic day, by Lady Lunafreya's side. Perhaps there is some solace that they could remain together to the end. Umbra must be distraught, having lost his mistress and dear friend.", 'May the stars watch over you, Prince Noctis.']

Title: Final Fantasy XV

What about my—I mean, our—picture with Cindy!?', 'Dude!', "I can't just go over and ask Our Goddess for a picture! That would be blasphemy!", 'Wow... You look just like a real Assassin!', "Bad news, Noct: the empire's here.", "She doesn't stand a chance against the imperial army all by herself!", 'Off looking at cars.', "Alright, let's go! You don't think they'd hurt her... ?", "It's like they assassinated our plans of having fun at the festival.", "Yeah. They've got the Regalia surrounded.", "Right. I'll tell Iggy we'll meet up with 'em later.", "No! We'd just be putting her in more danger.", "I never said I had a better idea! But I did hear her say Loqi's men stole her keycards. Maybe we could start by stealing them back.", "Yeah, I think so. I'm worried about the others.", "Don't stand so close to me.", 'The Prince of Garbage!', 'You having fun in there?', 'What does it look like inside?', "Oh, sounds like this isn't your first time breaking and entering.", "They've blocked off the main entrance!", 'But, who needs the power of kings... when you have the power of Assassins?', "Don't worry: I'll bring her back safe and sound.", 'You think?', 'Maybe real Assassins do. I mean, you just said it too!', 'On it!', 'You okay, Noct?', 'They gave up the search.', 'Could you not with the disappearing act?', 'How could I forget?', 'I bet!', 'Some guys never change, and Vyv is definitely one of those guys.', "Then let's get the shot and get outta here.", "Nice work, Noct. You're a natural!", "What's the empire doing here? Who invited them?", "They bring those troopers to life just to let 'em die... It's kinda sad, y'know?", '"Robots"... Right.', "Nothing! Just saying you're right. Well, break a leg! I mean, not literally.", 'Congratulations. So, are we done here?', 'Okay, great. Can we go now?', "Awesome. I'll text Iggy and everyone else the coordinates.", "We've gotta help Holly.", "I'm gonna lead all the people away from here. You'll slip into the crowd and sneak up on the soldier.", 'You? All by yourself?', "Don't worry: I'll bring her back safe and sound.", 'Well? Did you see him?', 'Got it!', 'There he is.', 'Not too slippery for us to catch.', "Not over here. C'mon!", "I bet they wouldn't see you up there!", "And I can't let myself hold you back. Go on without me. Good luck.", 'Who, me? Then I, Prompto Argentum, solemnly swear to protect Lady Cindy with my life!', "We can't keep this up!", "I can't take this much longer!", 'I can see the headlines: "The Assassins are out there!" Man, at this point, even I want to believe.', '"We"? I think all that cosplay has gone to your head.', 'Uh, nope.', 'I could never be like him.', "Now he's flirting with another girl!", 'I am disgusted.', 'You should offer that as a tribute to Our Goddess.', 'You sure about this, Noct?', "Okay. Thanks so much, Noct. I owe you one! It's gonna be my greatest picture yet. You'll see!", "I can't wait to see her smiling face!", 'Say "cheese"...', 'Where can we get some more of those wrenches?', 'If only it were that easy, Noct...', "Why do you call 'em that?", 'Gotta love that smell though, right?', "First let's see if we can score some spicy food.", 'Whole lotta land out there.', 'It would sure beat the hell out of walking.', 'Far cry from life back home.', 'Ever see so many stars?', 'Real quiet out here, far removed from the hustle and bustle of the crown city.', "Couldn't sleep at all last night, but then I had the weirdest dream.", 'Always wake up before I can remember anything.', 'You are a pretty deep sleeper... like under the ground deep.', "That's life in the crown city, waiting for the night to set you free.", "You reckon Cindy's taken?", 'Even to a Casanova like you?', "It just occurred to me, but this is totally like King's Knight.", "There's four of us, just like in the game!", "Oh, right—King's Knight! I bet my Zell tree's almost full.", "Man, wouldn't it be great if money grew on trees in real life?", 'And simple.', "Ha! I don't even wanna look at 'em!", "He's got a knife! Maybe it's for cooking?", 'Time to cut and run?', 'Boy, am I glad to have my voice back!', 'Heyyy!', "Yeah, let's stock up on everything!", 'Smell that fresh air—makes you feel alive!', "Wonder if I'll ever get the hang of all this fighting.", "Knock 'em dead, Noct! I'll be sure to get lots of pics!", "Nah, I think I'm okay!", "Don't you feel any jitters here on the front lines, Noct?", 'C-Cindy!? Where?', 'Those plants seem to have legs.', "And what if we don't?", 'Me-owch! That is one ferocious feline.', "Maybe it's just me, but I feel kinda bad taking those things down.", 'You mean it?', 'Yeah, we get that a lot.', 'You two are a couple of beasts!', "Wouldn't be the same without you, Ignis.", "Guuuh! Gladio! No no no! Don't even think about dying!"]

Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ["At last. A skilled hunter, worthy of my trade. I'm Randolph, the smithy. Bet you've heard my name. I make legends of men, forgin' 'em in my furnace.", "By making weapons like you've never seen. Weapons fit to be wielded by the hands that will shape the world. What say you? Are you man enough?", 'Bring me what I need. My creations require rare ores and wood, the finest around.', "Only the finest materials are fit for the legend we build. Finding them—it won't be easy.", 'That material has great power. And the power gives the weapon strength.', "I'm not like other smithies. Don't you ever lump me with them!", 'I will forge your legend with these two hands, before I die.', 'Is it a weapon worth dying for? Maybe not.', "That's it. You did good, hunter. Now you just leave the rest to me. You've taken the first step on a journey. I can see it in your eyes. The legend you will be. The legend goes with you.", "I feel it now. The legend is a-stirrin', waxin' strong. Don't delay. This is what you need next.", "We'll forget you another legend, hunter. The legend goes with you.", 'Ya ready to take the next step to becoming a legend? Then bring me this, and do not waver, no matter how daunting the task.', "We'll forge you another legend, hunter. The legend goes with you.", 'Ya ready to take the next step to becoming a legend? Then bring me this, and do not waver, no matter how daunting the task.', "We'll forge you another legend, hunter. The legend goes with you.", "Your legendary journey ain't over yet. Take the challenge. This is what I need.", "We'll forge you another legend, hunter. The legend goes with you. This is my last chapter. Everything I am, and ever have been, is in this weapon.", 'Fear not, lad. I have no intention of seeing the other side before I see this legend come to life. With this, the final chapter of the legend we have created draws to a close.', 'Legends never die. I will remain here until the next legend is ready to be forged.']

Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ['Lunafreya has absconded with it.', 'A moot point while the fugitives remain at large. My men and I will continue our search for the prince and the Oracle.', 'We believe the insurgents behind the Citadel attack have taken refuge in Duscae. The blockades shall help us root out the criminals. I realize the inconvenience imposed upon the citizenry, but we must each do our part for the good of all.', 'The cause of the tremors was the Archaean, who had awakened in a fit of rage. The imperial army took swift action and laid the unruly giant to rest, thus averting disaster.', 'Long has it been, Noctis.', "You receive the Storm's blessing. And yet, you know nothing of the consequences.", 'Be still. All of you.', 'Heir to a crown befitting no other. Witness his splendor and glory. All hail the Chosen King.', 'I do not serve. I command!', "The king's sworn shield.", 'A weak shield protects naught.', 'Should the Chosen fail, that too is fate.', 'Merely my duty.', 'No.', 'No, I cannot accept it.', 'By your hand it must be done.', "To deliver the ring and inspire the king is your calling. You mustn't fall.", 'Find it, Lunafreya. You have the will. Go to Noctis. Show him the truth of your heart.', 'Sister, cease this madness. That boy will never be King.', 'I know that you are throwing your life away!', 'Sister, cease this madness. That boy will never be King.', 'I know that you are throwing your life away!', 'Kill me... End it...', 'By the hand of the Oracle, they are with the King now—their rightful owner. And someday soon, he shall use them to purge our star of its scourge.', 'Nay, it is Noctis and none other.', 'Certainly not a puppet of the darkness and the daemons it has borne.', "At last you have arrived, Noctis. The gods have shown you their favor. As Blood of the Oracle, I present you your father's glaive.", 'Now go forth, my king. Shine your light unto the world.']

Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ['The decreed hour is come. Set forth with my blessing, Prince Noctis.', 'Take your leave, and go in the grace of the gods.', 'I fear I have left too much unsaid. You place a great burden on those who would bear with you.', 'I ask not that you guide my wayward son, merely that you remain at his side.', 'And another thing.', 'Do mind your manners around your charming bride-to-be.', 'You have no cause for concern.', 'Take heed. Once you set forth, you cannot turn back.', 'I need only know that you are ready to leave home behind.', 'Take care on the long road.', 'Wheresoever you should go, the line of Lucis goes with you.', 'Walk tall, my son.', 'Dearest Luna. You did well to deliver the ring to Noctis. Wayward though my son may indeed be... He has made me proud. May you two know happiness.']

Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ['Curiosity may bring you to the door—but no further.', 'It would be a downright shame to go all that way, only to find yourself locked out of the last door.', "Believe me—opportunity doesn't knock when the door is locked. Be sure to bring the key in with you.", "What is it now? If you don't mind, I'm rather busy at the moment.", "Oh, it's you boys. Wait, who're you again? And what do you need now?", "You're saying you distracted me for nothing? This won't do, won't do at all. Precious seconds down the drain. How am I to make up for them? Of course! You boys can help me!", "That's the spirit! I was just thinking I could use a few extra hands—for catching frogs, to be precise.", "Ah, and if you're thinking any old frog will do? Wrong! You're not getting off that easily. Only the red frog native to Alstor suits my needs. You'll need to get knee and elbow deep down at the Slough. With that, I'll get back to my work. Remember, it's red frogs. And make sure they're fresh!", "You're combat-trained, I'd wager. I can tell by looking at your efficient musculature.", "You'll find red frogs at the Alstor Slough. Bring me live specimens as quick as you can.", 'Look at all these lovelies! Thank you, boys. Now my research can spring along.', "From longer nights to earthquakes, there's been a lot of strange phenomena of late. The world's out of whack, and there's no end to the mysteries that want for solving.", "Yep. You see, red frogs only appeared recently. We don't know what gave rise to the mutation. But this tiny critter could hold the key to the world's mysteries in its webbed feet. Fascinating stuff, right? When can you help again?", "Well, when you can, you let me know. For now, here's a token of my thanks for finding the frogs. You've earned it!", "Looky here! If it isn't you boys again. Come to offer your support for my research, have you? Well, how very heartening!", 'Now, it just so happens I already have in mind what I need you to fetch me this time. Off you go now!', 'Never enough hours in a day, or enough hands to help out.', "Don't go losing your hard-found specimens. Make a beeline for me as soon as you nab 'em.", "My research is stalled until you procure my specimens. In layman's terms: move it, move it!", "Out in the wilds, it's survival of the fittest. Don't die, now.", "With our efforts combined, we might cast light on the world's darkest mysteries! Isn't it exciting?", "Wow, the condition is superb! Here's your hard-earned reward. Now then, let's see what answers I can coax out of this.", 'Oh. Come to observe fauna, have you?', "Oh! It's you lot!", 'You came to see me? Aww, how sweet!', 'How are you?', 'What brings you to these parts?', "Ooh, you couldn't have come at a better time. Here's your next assignment. Make sure you hand it in like a good student!", "Back so soon? You're getting quicker at this. Good! Science waits for no man.", "Hey there. So, by now you must've gotten used to the fieldwork. I think it's time you graduated from frogs. It'll mean more work, of course, but then you'll be exposed to more modes of life. Well worth the effort, I think.", 'Ooh, this specimen is absolutely perfect. Nary a flaw. You deserve a prize!', "You really have a knack for being at the right place, at the right time. Here's what I need. Hop to it, now!", "Wow, the condition is superb! Here's your hard-earned reward. Now then, let's see what answers I can coax out of this.", "Ooh, you couldn't have come at a better time. Here's your next assignment. Make sure you hand it in like a good student!", 'There you are, and with precisely what I asked for! Here, take this to commemorate your coming back in one piece.', "Oh, it's you boys again, back to sweat for science!", 'Your words say "no," but your expression betrays an irrepressible desire to lend a hand.', 'Loads of things. But what\'s captured my interest right now is the legendary rainbow frog. There\'s nary a reliable eyewitness account, and the only clue I have as to their habitat is "water." That\'s it. Useless, I know. But that\'s where we are without the data to narrow down the search. Be that as it may, I can\'t bring myself to give up on the critters. Even if they\'re more elusive than a pot of gold at the end of the rainbow, I have my pride as the foremost authority on frogs. And so I leave the search to you! Not much info to work with, though, so you\'ll just have to play it by ear.', "You found them! The rainbow frogs of legend... I never dreamed I'd see you babies in the slimy flesh!", 'Thank you. I had foreseen this, but biology is your destiny. Give up hunting and join me!', 'You burn for the science. How else could you have managed to track down the rainbow frog?', "Oh, really? All of a sudden? And what's got you so busy?", "Royal stuff? Ahhh, the royal theater! Well then, that changes everything. Artsy types just aren't cut out for science. What a shame.", "It wasn't meant to be. But no matter what path you walk, I'm sure you'll walk it well. This is it, then. The final token of my thanks. All the best with theater—I'll come see a play one day.", 'Not right now! Important research.', 'Well, look what the coeurl dragged in! You boys curious about these quakes, too?', "As it were, I was going through some old biology docs, and I stumbled upon something that might pique your interest. Longwythe Peak! Ooh, baby, this is monumental. I've gotta check it out up close!", 'So, you made it out alive! Not bad. Thanks to you boys, my research of Longwythe is going swimmingly.']

Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ["Tales of the past and hopes for the future are manifest in the King of Kings. The Frostbearer's blessing shall be his.", 'The Six have safeguarded this star since time immemorial—each of a different mind, but united by this common purpose.', 'The gods\' protection extends to all creatures here below—even to the mortals created in their image. They are feeble creatures leading fragile lives and clinging to foolish fancies. The Frostbearer scorns these visions of "hope" which melt like snow in the sun\'s light.', 'Yet the Pyreburner admires their strength of will. For their reverence, he grants unto them his flame, and the world of man flourishes.', 'His benevolence warms the heart of the Frostbearer.', 'It is not long, however, before some among those men ascend to new heights of hubris. The people of Solheim spurn the gods who blessed them—the gods they once worshipped.', 'The ungrateful mortals incur the wrath of the Pyreburner. He seeks to raze the very civilization his flames once helped build.', 'But the Six are sworn to defend the star and all its inhabitants from harm—and, at times, from one another.', "The flames of war surge as Solheim fends off the Pyreburner's fire. The gods' pleas for peace fall on deaf ears, and the battle rages on. When the smoke clears, the world of man is in ruins, their star left scarred for time eternal. Wearied from war, the Six seek solace in slumber.", 'This tale of our shared past is entrusted to the King of Kings...', '... that he may see it to its conclusion.', 'In the days that follow the war, while the Six are still asleep, the Pyreburner is sought by a man who draws him away from the Light.', 'His peril is sensed by the Frostbearer. She rushes to his aid, only to be felled by the foreign hordes.', 'Those masses are now one with the darkness—darkness that, before long, will swallow the Six and the star they protect.', "This star's fate no longer rests in the hands of the gods. It sits on the shoulders of the Chosen.", 'Deliver this world from darkness—and grant my love release.', 'The Oracle is no longer of this world, but her thoughts remain—and they must be known.', 'When the boy begins his existence on this star, the girl is met by the High Messenger.', 'It is ordained that she will work with him to return the Light. The girl reaffirms that promise.', "The High Messenger is moved by the girl's determination, her heart warmed by the girl's benevolence. Her faith in mankind is restored once more.", 'And so the promise is fulfilled. As her words go with him, so shall my blessing.', 'O King of Kings, restore the Light unto this world.', 'Pyreburner. That heart of flame was turned to ash once... A dead fire must burn no more. Taste again the chill wind of death.', 'O Chosen King of the Stone, restore the Light to this world.', 'Rest, my love. May your soul know peace at last. King of Kings, the grace of the gods is with you always.']

Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ["Y'all hungry for info?", "Well, if it ain't the boys with the fancy automobile.", "Y'all wanna fetch some edibles for me?", "Well, it's just that ol' Cid...", "Yep. Said I should give y'all some work, don't matter what kind. Seein' as you boys can't go home for the time bein'.", "So y'all gotta learn about the wider world. If y'all can't find the stuff I need, it ain't no big deal. But... it'd surely help me out if you could.", "Cid's, uh... He's worried about you boys, y'know.", "I'll cook you up somethin' good. That'll make you feel better.", "Oh-ho. Y'all went an' got what I asked for.", "Yeah, well. Guess I went a little soft on you. I'l be sure to give you more of a challenge next time. How's about that? Anyhoo, I appreciate yer help. Here's a little care package. Should make fer good eatin'.", "Oh! Hey, boys. You got time to lend a fella a helpin' hand?", "Nope, this one's gonna take some effort. I'm sendin' y'all straight to the source this time. In other words, it's huntin' time. The stuff I want y'all to collect, I'm fixin' to use in a new dish. Hope you can help me out.", 'I got the new recipe all set, right here in my noggin. Just need the ingredients.', "If anythin' bad happens, Cid'll be madder than a shaved possum. So y'all take care.", 'How was the hunt, boys?', "Somethin' I know you'll like.", "Yep. So y'all make sure you drop by and order some. In the meantime, this here'll put some meat on yer bones.", 'There ya are. So, uh, you wanna do me a favor?', "Another hunt. My cupboard's darn near empty.", "Knew I could count on y'all. Good huntin'!", "Well, I got careless an' ran out ‘fore I even noticed.", "Sometimes it's faster to ask a hunter to bring it direct, than trek to the shops in town.", 'Fact is, I know I can count on you boys.', "Y'all really came through. Now I've got enough stock for weeks.", "Did a little when I was a young'un. Chased down folks, beggin' 'em for food with nothin' but my knife. But that was no life. Ever since Cid came and bailed me out... I only ever use my knife in the kitchen. This here's for y'all. It'll fill ya up, and taste good goin' down.", "Got a job for y'all, if you've got time.", "Somethin' nasty's holdin' up my supplier, so now I'm runnin' low on beans.", "Don't like 'em?", "That's 'cause you ain't never had 'em cooked right. I simmer 'em long an' slow. Leastways, when I have 'em. I'd be real grateful if y'all would help.", 'What about greens? You hate them, too?', "Hmm... You say ya hate beans, son, but I reckon a batch of mine'll change your mind.", 'Good news: all my deliveries finally came in.', "Beans are healthy and nutritious. What's not to like?", "You wanna hear a tip from an ol' pro? Forget they're beans... Pretend they're little meatballs!", "I reckon y'all earned this reward. It'll make a fine meal. An' be sure to kiss the cook for me.", 'Good to see ya, son.', "Y'all happen to be headed for Lestallum?", "‘Cause it'd be mighty helpful if y'all could do some shoppin'.", "Much obliged t'ya.", "Lestallum ain't exactly a stone's throw away.", "If y'all bring back enough of the stuff, I oughta be set for quite some time.", 'Well, look at all that. You boys brought back a whole truckload!', 'How much?', "Whoa. Now, y'all didn't pull a heist, did ya?", "Forgive me, son. Just reminded me of my own past is all. Musta been thirty years ago. Once tried to steal food from here—'til ol' Cid done caught me. Rapped me right on the noggin an' took me in. This here'll keep ya fed, so, uh, you won't have to steal.", 'Hey there.', "Y'all got spare time?", "Yep. An' it's a dangerous one.", 'Sure do.', 'Thanks, son.', "Always wanted to try whippin' up a dish with this.", "So y'all got what I asked for. Tell me now. Do you boys like steak?", "Good. Y'see, the last few jobs I gave you, they weren't from Cid—they were from me. And I reckon you deserve somethin' by way of thanks. So I'm fixin' to create a whole new recipe in your honor. A heartfelt token of my ‘preciation.", "So y'all make sure ya order it next time you're around.", "Any-hoo. This is yer pay for the hunt. It's good eatin'. Take it from me.", "All these recent quakes are givin' me the chills.", "Can't even boil a pot of water without worryin' it's gonna spill all over the place! Only got a splash of stock left in the fridge. Like to run dry if these quakes don't quiet down soon.", "Finally, I can cook in peace, an' it's thanks to y'all. Ah, the sounds of simmerin'—music to my ears!"]

Title: Final Fantasy XV
Dialogues: ['Prince Noctis! Iris is safe with me!', 'You got it!', "So, there's this legend about a sword. And the sword's supposed to be behind a waterfall nearby.", "You're welcome!", 'You got it!', 'That sword you found behind the waterfall? It is the same sword as the one from the legend in this town!', "You're welcome!", "I'm sure the sword's there. I'm sorry if it isn't.", 'Everybody here knows the legend, even grown-ups!', "Maybe you'll find some cool treasure.", 'Prince Noctis! Welcome back!', "I... I couldn't stop them.", 'I believe in you, Prince Noctis.', 'Prince Noctis! Hey! Our house is over here! Right this way!', "I think Miss Cindy might've told you already, but she needs a very special kind of ore called mythril to fix the boat. Remember the waterfall? I read in Grandpa's notebook there's some ruins near a lake just north of there. It said you'll find mythril inside!", 'Look, Prince Noctis! Even the marshal came to say goodbye!', "I heard the Regalia's going on the boat with you!", "You didn't forget to pack anything, did you?", 'Have a safe trip, Prince Noctis.', "Don't you worry. I'm gonna be strong and keep everyone safe while you're gone!", 'Hey! Your Majesty!', 'Please come back soon! We need our king!', 'Uh...', "It's me, Talcott. My grandpa served the Amicitia family?", 'Yeah.', 'Yes way. Welcome back, Your Majesty.', "Yes, sir, that's—that's right. Hm? Oh. Just a second.", 'Said he wants to have a word with you?', 'He said you can have it in person. Okay. We should be there shortly, sir.', "Wow. I can't tell you how good it is to see you again.", "You think so? Guess I've grown some these ten years.", 'The guys must be pinching themselves right now.', 'Lestallum, more often than not, but they take a lot of trips to Hammerhead.', "For Miss Cindy—y'know, back at the garage. She's a tough one, but when she needs a little extra muscle out on the road, she gives 'em a call.", "Ah—speaking of which, the guys said they're near Hammerhead right now, so we'll be meeting them there. Y'know, ever since you disappeared, Your Majesty, it's been nothing but nighttime nonstop. Lestallum still has light—thanks to the power plant—so just about everyone's taken refuge there.", 'Everywhere else\'s been abandoned. Daemons moved in, forcing the people to move out. People still swing by the garage at Hammerhead from time to time, but it usually isn\'t for repairs. These days, it\'s less of a service station and more of a "slayer station"—a base for daemon-hunting. The garage\'s still open, though... one of the few places that is.', 'He\'s kicking alright, just not as hard as before. He hasn\'t really been himself lately. At lesat, not since he moved out to Lestallum. Someone suggested he move the garage there, too... ... but old man Cid wasn\'t having it. He called it "a big, fat chocobo turd of an idea." Said it just wouldn\'t be the same anywhere else.', 'Miss Cindy said she didn\'t mind either way, so the garage will probably stay put for a while. And without any tinkering to do, Ignig\'s gourmet seafood is about all Cid has left to look forward to. With all the daemons prowling around, more folk were getting hurt... or worse. So Iris talked the marshal into taking out the daemons themselves. "Iris the Daemon Slayer," they call her. Gladio and the others, they lend \'em a hand whenever they can. Prompto spends most of his time hunting around Hammerhead. He tries to impress Miss Cindy... but she\'s already married to her work.', "He hunts, too. We tried to stop him, but he wouldn't listen. He said, if anything, he's more used to the darkness than we are.", "I'm afraid not. But, that being said, he gets by pretty well on his own. Gladio and Prompto usually hunt on their own as well. It isn't often you see the three of them together nowadays. They still work as a team every once in a while, but each has his own set of tasks to keep him busy.", "We've arrived, Your Majesty. Everyone'll be so happy to see you. Don't worry—I won't be going anywhere. If you have any other questions, please don't hesitate to ask.", "I'm more than happy to tell you everything I know.", "We've even got some former imperials fighting for us. The toughest of 'em said she used to lead a band of mercenaries.", "So you do know her. I'm not surprised; the marshal said she used to be feared far and wide back in the day. But now she's revered among the Lucian masses—same with her men, Biggs and Wedge. Each of them leads their own small army.", 'Oh, right—about the empire.', 'Gladio brought back word that both the emperor and high commander were dead. With those two gone, Niflheim pretty much fell apart.', "The chancellor's still around, though... in Insomnia. Nobody who saw him had any clue what he might have been up to, but their stories piqued Ignis's curiosity. I ended up helping Ignis look into the matter—digging through old records, even joining him on trips to the royal tombs.", "It's cool—I'm a bit of a history buff myself. But we did discover something pretty weird.", "While we were poring over all those ancient texts, one name caught our eye: Ardyn's. Apparently he was hailed as a savior, healing all those who were ravaged by daemons... ... only to end up branded a daemon himself—a dubious charge, I'd say. By all accounts, he was just as human as you and me.", "On the bright side, we've come a little closer to understanding the daemons. Y'see, I'd always thought they were animals, only more hideous and savage. But... it turns out they're just ordinary people... ... unlucky folk infected by something or other that transformed them into monsters. There's no known cure as of yet, so death is the only mercy.", 'All these years, and you remembered.', 'Your Majesty... do you remember my grandfather?', 'There\'s something I wasn\'t able to tell you back then. Grandpa died because of me... It was my fault. An imperial officer approached me in town, asked if I was from the Crown City. And that was just the beginning: "What brings you here, young man? You didn\'t come here by yourself, did you?" "Your grandfather is a butler at a manor? How very grand!" "He rubs shoulders with the royal family? You must be ever so proud!" I answered him without thinking. A little after that, the man showed up at our hotel.', "Think what you will of me, but please know that Grandpa didn't give you away.", 'Yeah?', "I suppose you're right, Your Majesty. Thank you.", "Prince Noctis! Are you helping look for earthquakes? Well, guess what—I'm helping, too!", "I started looking in Grandpa's notebook, and here's what I found. It said there's a legend about the mountain, and that's all he wrote. Oh! But y'know what else? He drew a picture of a turtle. Not only was Grandpa smart, but he was a good drawer.", "You defeated an adamantoise!? Woah! I'm gonna write that down in Grandpa's notebook!"]
